jobDescription:
We are looking for a hands-on Data Scientist / ML Engineer to build and deploy credit risk and decisioning models for an NBFC/banking environment. The role focuses on production-grade machine learning systems, including model development, deployment, scalability, and integration into decision engines. This is not a research-heavy AI role-the expectation is strong ownership of end-to-end pipelines, from data to production, with emphasis on robustness, performance, and business impact.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Credit Risk & Decisioning Models

  • Develop and maintain models for:
  • Credit risk (PD, delinquency, segmentation)
  • Customer behaviour (collections, engagement, response)
  • Income estimation / surrogate modelling (where applicable)
  • Work with bureau data (e.g., CIBIL/CRIF), transactional data, and alternative data sources
  • Translate business policies into model-driven decision frameworks

2. Data Engineering & Feature Pipelines

  • Build scalable feature pipelines using: - Python / PySpark / SQL
  • Handle large-scale datasets (structured + semi-structured)
  • Implement robust feature engineering (e.g., bureau features, exposure, EMI, leverage, etc.)

3. Model Deployment & Integration

  • Deploy models into production systems using: - Docker, Kubernetes, or similar containerization tools
  • Integrate models with decision engines / APIs
  • Ensure low-latency and high-throughput inference pipelines

4. MLOps, Testing & Monitoring

  • Implement: - Integration testing for model pipelines - Stress testing (performance under load) - Model monitoring (drift, stability, performance) -
  • Work with DevOps teams to ensure reliable production systems
  • Handle versioning, rollback strategies, and model lifecycle management

5. Cloud & Infrastructure

  • Work on AWS-based environments (or equivalent cloud platforms)
  • Understand distributed systems and compute optimization
  • Optimize pipelines for performance and cost?

6. Cross-functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with: - Risk teams - Product / business stakeholders - Data engineering & platform teams
  • Translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions

title: AEO & GEO Lead
jobDescription:
Job Summary

Spring Health is looking for an AEO GEO Lead to own how our brand and content perform across AI-powered search and discovery. This role will span both our B2B and direct-to-consumer businesses, with responsibility for improving how Spring Health is found, understood and cited by the platforms people increasingly use to research, compare and make decisions.

This is a technical, hands-on role for someone who knows how to turn AEO and GEO into an operating system. You ll build and run the experimentation engine, test what improves crawlability, retrieval, visibility and citation, ship changes quickly and use the results to decide what to scale. You ll work across web, data and technical teams to make sure Spring Health s digital presence is structured to perform as AI discovery continues to evolve, and youll connect that performance to traffic, demand and pipeline. You ll own the process end to end. Sometimes that means creating content yourself. Other times it means using AI, briefing a freelancer, working with an internal expert or partnering with web and engineering. The goal is figuring out what gets Spring Health discovered and cited, then building a repeatable system around it. Reporting to the Senior Director, B2B Content and Communications, this is a full time, fully remote position on our team. Occasional travel may be required for team or company events/meetings.

What you ll be doing

  • Build and own Spring Health s company-wide AEO and GEO strategy, spanning both B2B employer and D2C member audiences.
  • Test content, page structures, formats, sources, authorship signals and technical changes to understand what actually drives AI visibility and citation.
  • Monitor how major AI and search platforms crawl, index, retrieve and cite Spring Health information.
  • Partner with Web and Engineering to address technical barriers and improve structured data, schema, semantic HTML, internal linking, site architecture and crawlability.
  • Own onsite/offsite content as discovery and experimentation surfaces.
  • Extend visibility strategies across relevant third-party platforms and communities that influence AI-powered discovery and brand authority.
  • Maximize the long-term discovery value of high-priority content and thought leadership.
  • Ensure AEO and GEO standards are consistently applied across Spring Health's broader digital content ecosystem.
  • Build and own the AEO scorecard. Connect AI discovery performance to traffic, demand and pipeline impact.
  • Use AI and automation extensively to accelerate research, content development, testing, monitoring and analysis.
  • Serve as the company-wide expert on AEO and AI discovery as the space continues to change.
  • You ll work across communications, marketing, web and other teams to turn Spring Health s expertise into content that AI engines can find, understand and cite. You ll have AI tools and flexible creative resources to help you move quickly, while you stay focused on the strategy, experimentation and technical work that drives AI visibility.

What success looks like in this role

  • Improve Spring Health s visibility and citation across priority AI-powered search and answer platforms for B2B and consumer.
  • Increase qualified website traffic and engagement from AI-powered search and discovery channels.
  • Launch and evaluate a consistent pipeline of AEO and GEO experiments, using results to determine what approaches should be scaled.
  • Improve the technical readiness of priority web content for crawling, retrieval and citation, including structured data, site architecture and content structure.
  • Demonstrate measurable contribution from AI search and discovery efforts to business outcomes such as leads, opportunities and pipeline.

What you ll bring

  • 5+ years of experience in technical SEO or search visibility, with full-time focus on AEO and GEO in recent years.
  • Hands-on experience improving visibility across AI-powered search and answer engines such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity or Google AI experiences.
  • A strong understanding of how search engines and LLM-based systems crawl, index, retrieve and cite web content.
  • Technical fluency with structured data, schema/JSON-LD, semantic HTML, site architecture, rendering, canonicalization, internal linking and indexing.
  • A strong experimentation mindset. You form a hypothesis, get something live, inspect what happened and make the next decision from the evidence.
  • Experience with Google Search Console, Semrush, Ahrefs and AI visibility platforms.
  • The ability to create and modify content when needed without relying on a traditional editorial production process.
  • Strong AI fluency and experience using automation to accelerate research, creation, testing and analysis.
  • The ability to brief and manage freelancers and internal subject matter experts to get work shipped quickly.
  • Strong analytical judgment. The measurement in this space is still developing, and you need to be comfortable deciding what is signal and what is noise.
  • The ability to work effectively with Web, Engineering, Data, Marketing and Communications teams.
  • A track record of building new capabilities without waiting for someone else to hand you the playbook.
  • Demonstrated ability to connect search and AI visibility performance to pipeline and revenue outcomes.

Nice to have

  • Experience with server logs or crawler analysis
  • Basic HTML/CSS, Python or SQL, APIs and automated workflows
  • Experience with proprietary research, or healthcare and other regulated categories.
  • In-house B2B or B2B SaaS experience is strongly preferred.

jobDescription:
About Us
CLOUDSUFI is a Silicon Valley-based specialist Data Engineering Cloud Technologies player with top-tier clients, favorable revenue mix, strong financial performance, and robust management. We help organizations with Data Discovery, Insights, and Monetization, offering our engineers the opportunity to work on new platforms and technologies-including Cloud Hyper Scalers and AI/ML/NLP-that put them ahead of peers in the IT Services industry. Started in 2019, CLOUDSUFI is a family of 250+ members working towards a common goal of making enterprise data dance.

This role sits within CLOUDSUFI s live engagement where AI is already embedded operationally across reliability and platform engineering-not a future aspiration. The team runs an AI SRE co-pilot that reasons across observability, cloud, and ticketing platforms; a set of purpose-built AI sub-agents for incident triage, monitor hygiene, and usage/cost attribution; and a formal AI governance program that assesses CLOUDSUFI s own internal AI agents for risk before they touch production. You will be embedded with the client s SRE function supporting a regulated consumer-lending platform on AWS-hundreds of microservices, event-driven pipelines, and customer-facing loan origination and servicing journeys where reliability is directly a customer-trust and compliance concern. As a Junior SRE Engineer, you will work under the guidance of senior engineers and architects to support, operate, and learn from this AI-driven reliability program.
Responsibilities - AI-Driven Initiatives

1. AI-Augmented Incident Response Root Cause Analysis
  • Support incident response as a shadow or secondary responder, using AI-driven detection, correlation, and root-cause analysis tooling under the guidance of senior engineers to speed up triage.
  • Help assemble incident timelines from metrics, logs, traces, and deploy history, learning to separate the alert that fired from the change that actually caused it.
  • Help operate and monitor the existing AI SRE sub-agents (covering areas such as incident summarization, monitor-gap detection, and usage attribution), flagging anomalies or failures for senior review.
  • Assist in documenting AI-assisted incident findings and postmortems, including tracking corrective and preventive actions through to closure.

2. AI-Driven Observability Alert Quality
  • Build and maintain monitors, dashboards, and SLO definitions in Datadog as code via Terraform , rather than clicking through the UI.
  • Assist in reducing alert noise using AI/ML-assisted detection (anomaly, outlier, and forecast monitors, composite conditions, and dynamic thresholds) so that pages stay actionable and rare.
  • Run recurring monitor-hygiene and coverage-gap reviews - no-data monitors, missing no-data notification, orphaned monitors on decommissioned services, and monitors with no owning team tag or valid notification target.
  • Support SLI/SLO and error-budget reviews for critical customer journeys, escalating services trending toward budget exhaustion to senior team members.

3. AI-Enabled Cloud Reliability, Capacity Cost Engineering
  • Support day-to-day reliability of AWS workloads - ECS/Fargate, EKS, Lambda, RDS/Aurora, ALB, SQS/SNS and Step Functions - under senior guidance.
  • Use predictive analytics and intelligent monitoring dashboards to spot capacity, saturation, and cost anomalies across host, container, log, APM, and serverless usage, escalating notable trends with evidence.
  • Assist in observability and cloud cost governance , attributing spend and telemetry volume to owning teams and services and helping identify low-value, high-cost signals.

4. AI Governance, Risk Reliability Reviews (Learning Track)
  • Participate in architecture and design reviews, learning how reliability risk and AI-agent risk (e.g., prompt injection, authorization gaps, secrets exposure in agent and tool configuration, blast radius of autonomous actions) is assessed and documented.
  • Learn how production-readiness, change management, and audit expectations apply in a regulated environment (PCI-DSS, SOC 2, SOX, GLBA), and why observability evidence matters to auditors.
  • Assist in tracking action items from the AI-risk and reliability remediation roadmap and help prepare status updates for stakeholders.

5. AI-Enabled DevOps, CI/CD Automation
  • Support the implementation of reliability and safety controls within CI/CD pipelines , learning automation-first and AI-augmented approaches and shift-left practices from senior engineers.
  • Help integrate AI-assisted checks (e.g., change-risk summaries, infrastructure drift detection, dependency and configuration checks) into the delivery lifecycle.
  • Write and maintain automation in Python and Bash against platform APIs (Datadog, AWS, GitHub, PagerDuty, Jira) to replace recurring manual work, and contribute Terraform modules and pull requests under review.
  • Assist with runbook creation and the progressive automation of runbook steps toward self-healing.

6. AI-Enabled Program Workflow Support
  • Support multiple concurrent reliability initiatives using AI-enabled workflow and tracking tools shared across SRE and Security teams.
  • Help promote a reliability-first culture by learning and sharing data-driven, AI-backed operational practices with the wider team.

SRE Cloud Capabilities
  • Interest in observability and monitoring fundamentals - metrics, logs, traces, and APM - and a willingness to learn predictive analytics and anomaly detection.
  • Exposure to at least one observability platform (Datadog preferred; Grafana/Prometheus, New Relic, CloudWatch, or ELK/OpenSearch also relevant).
  • Foundational understanding of SLI, SLO, and error-budget concepts, and of why alert fatigue is a reliability problem rather than an annoyance.
  • Hands-on exposure to AWS (or an equivalent hyperscaler) across compute, networking, storage, and managed database services, with interest in automated reliability tooling.
  • Foundational knowledge of container and orchestration concepts (Docker, ECS or Kubernetes) and of serverless execution models.
  • Beginner-to-intermediate familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform preferred; Ansible or CloudFormation acceptable) and an eagerness to build deeper IaC expertise.
  • Basic Linux troubleshooting and networking fundamentals, including DNS, TLS, load balancing, timeouts and retries.
  • Some hands-on exposure to automation or scripting (Python, Bash, or similar), including consuming REST APIs and parsing JSON.
  • Comfort with Git and pull-request-based workflows, and exposure to CI/CD tooling (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, ArgoCD or similar).
  • Familiarity with incident management and on-call concepts, including severity models, escalation policies, and paging tools such as PagerDuty or Opsgenie.
  • Basic exposure to cloud posture and continuous monitoring concepts, and to change and release management discipline.
  • Practical curiosity about LLM-based assistants and agents applied to operations, and about how to verify whether their output is actually correct.
About You
  • 1-3 years of experience in SRE, DevOps, cloud infrastructure, platform, or production-support engineering, with an eagerness to build deeper expertise in infrastructure as code.
  • Some exposure to cloud-native logging and monitoring tools, and interest in AI-driven alerting and noise reduction.
  • You debug from evidence: when something breaks, your instinct is to look at the data before offering a theory, and you are comfortable saying I don t know yet, here is what I am checking.
  • You would rather automate a task the second time you do it than the tenth.
  • Coursework or hands-on exposure to monitoring and observability platforms.
  • Exposure to CI/CD pipelines and interest in integrating reliability controls and shift-left practices.
  • Basic understanding of capacity, performance, and reliability cost concepts, including risk-based prioritization of remediation work.
  • Awareness of common compliance frameworks (PCI-DSS, SOC 2, SOX, HIPAA/GLBA) and comfort working with production-change discipline.
  • Willingness to learn incident management processes, including AI-assisted triaging, and the judgment to escalate early rather than sit quietly on an uncertain production signal.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with curiosity to assess simple architectures for failure modes under senior guidance.
  • Clear written communication - you can explain an incident, a metric, or a trade-off to someone who was not in the room.
  • Interest in learning how reliability standards, operational policies, and governance frameworks are developed and maintained, including for AI-agent usage.

Core Competencies
Working knowledge of, or strong willingness to learn, several of the following domains:
  • Site Reliability Engineering fundamentals (SLI/SLO, error budgets, toil reduction)
  • Observability and Monitoring (metrics, logs, distributed tracing, APM, RUM/Synthetics)
  • AIOps basics - anomaly detection, event correlation, predictive analytics, alert noise reduction
  • Incident Response and Postmortem/RCA practice
  • Cloud Infrastructure (AWS core services, multi-account and IAM basics)
  • Containers and Orchestration (Docker, ECS, Kubernetes)
  • Infrastructure as Code and Configuration Management (Terraform, Ansible)
  • CI/CD, Release Engineering and Progressive Delivery
  • Automation and Scripting (Python, Bash, platform APIs)
  • Capacity, Performance and Reliability Cost Engineering (FinOps fundamentals)
  • Resilience Patterns (retries, timeouts, circuit breakers, graceful degradation)
  • Chaos/Failure-Injection and Disaster Recovery concepts
  • Runbook Automation, Automated Remediation and Self-Healing (exposure)
  • DevSecOps and secure-by-default operations fundamentals
  • AI Agent Risk Governance basics (authorization models, prompt-injection risk, secrets exposure in AI tool configs, human-in-the-loop controls)

Preferred Certifications
  • AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner / Associate-level AWS certification (preferred, not required)
  • HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate (preferred, not required)
  • Datadog Fundamentals or an equivalent observability-platform certification (preferred, not required)
  • Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) or KCNA (preferred, not required)
  • Exposure to AI/ML applications in operations and reliability is a plus (preferred, not required)

Required Skills

SRE Observability AI-reliability AI-Observability AI

Job Summary
WJCF is an Indian non-profit organisation committed to saving lives by reducing the burden of disease and strengthening government-owned, high-quality health systems. Since 2007, WJCF has combined data-driven approaches and deep public health expertise with strong government partnerships to design, implement, and scale solutions across India s national and state health programmes. We work for and at the service of governments - supporting the Ministry of Health Family Welfare and State Departments of Health to build systems that are strong, sustainable, and led by Indian institutions.
As an Indian organisation, WJCF brings an unmatched depth of contextual understanding of India s health system architecture, policy landscape, and implementation realities across diverse geographies and population groups. This local institutional credibility, combined with global technical rigour, is central to WJCF s effectiveness as a partner to governments and donors.
Our work is built around four complementary roles: as a Trusted Government Partner, co-designing programmes and strengthening health system architecture; as an Operational Partner, translating strategies into effective on-the-ground delivery; as a Market Shaper, improving the availability and affordability of health commodities; and as an Ecosystem Catalyst, convening governments, development partners, academia, and the private sector to drive solutions at scale.
WJCF s programme portfolio spans thematic areas like hepatitis, HIV/AIDS, tuberculosis, vector-borne diseases), syphilis, cervical cancer, diabetes, maternal and childhood anaemia, immunisation, under-5 diarrhoea and pneumonia, sexual and reproductive health, Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri - Jan Arogya Yojana (AB PM-JAY), Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM), hypoxemia and oxygen, safe drinking water, sickle cell disease, presbyopia, lead poisoning, and cross cutting thematic areas like AI and Health, integrated disease surveillance, and climate and health.
We currently support programmes across 19 states and union territories, with teams working at national, state, district, and sub-district levels.
Our people are our greatest asset. WJCF brings together a talented, diverse team of professionals from public health, analytics, consulting, healthcare, the development sector, and academia, all united by a shared commitment to improving health outcomes for the people of India. We are entrepreneurial, action-oriented, and deeply grounded in the communities and systems we work in. Our field teams collectively bring hundreds of years of experience managing public health programmes across the country.
WJCF collaborates with a range of international and domestic partners and donors to advance its mission, including an affiliation with the Clinton Health Access Initiative (CHAI), a global health organisation with which WJCF shares a common mission and values.


Programme Overview
Vector Borne Diseases (VBDs) such as malaria, visceral leishmaniasis (VL, also called kala-azar), lymphatic filariasis (LF), dengue, chikungunya, and Japanese encephalitis remain major public health concerns in India.
India has achieved remarkable reductions in VBD cases and deaths over recent decades. Malaria cases have reduced from 75 million at the time of India s independence to ~200,00 in 2023-24, while deaths have reduced from 800,000 to 83 during the same period. For LF, though active transmission and infection rates have declined, the chronic manifestations remain significant. India reported about ~600,00 lymphoedema cases and ~125,000 hydrocele cases caused by filarial worms in 2023. For VL, cases have reduced to ~500 in 2023. The Government of India has committed to the elimination of several VBDs within defined timelines- for example, eliminating malaria by 2030 and lymphatic filariasis and kala-azar ahead of global targets.

jobDescription:
Job Summary
We are looking for an engineer experienced in deploying and optimizing Large Language Models on edge devices, preferably NVIDIA Jetson platforms. The role is not limited to model inference; the candidate should be able to design practical LLM-based solutions for real-world scenarios using prompt engineering, input preprocessing, caching strategies, data creation, and model fine-tuning when required. The ideal candidate should understand how to make LLM applications reliable, efficient, and context-aware under edge-device constraints such as limited compute, memory, latency, and power.


Responsibilities
Design practical LLM-based solutions for real-world scenarios using prompt engineering, input preprocessing, caching strategies, data creation, and model fine-tuning when required. Understand how to make LLM applications reliable, efficient, and context-aware under edge-device constraints such as limited compute, memory, latency, and power.


Mandatory Skills
  • Hands-on experience with LLMs, prompt engineering, and scenario-specific prompt design.
  • Experience running AI/ML models on edge devices with compute and memory constraints.
  • Practical knowledge of preprocessing techniques for text, speech transcripts, and structured inputs.
  • Experience implementing caching, context management, and optimization techniques for LLM applications.
  • Ability to create datasets and fine-tune or adapt models for domain-specific use cases.
  • Strong Python programming skills.
  • Understanding of NLP tasks such as intent handling, entity extraction, and text classification.
  • Experience with model evaluation, latency optimization, and debugging AI behavior.
  • Familiarity with NVIDIA Jetson or similar edge AI platforms.


Good to Have Skills
  • Experience with speech processing, speech-to-text systems, and audio preprocessing.
  • Knowledge of noise handling, speech enhancement, and robust voice input pipelines.

  • Familiarity with TensorRT, ONNX, PyTorch, Hugging Face, or similar model deployment tools.
  • Experience with quantization, pruning, distillation, or other model compression techniques.
  • Knowledge of retrieval-augmented generation, vector databases, or local knowledge caching.
  • Experience building real-time AI applications on embedded Linux systems.
  • Familiarity with multilingual or domain-specific language processing.
  • Experience integrating LLMs with sensors, robotics, industrial systems, or IoT devices.

About Centric Software:
Centric Software is a global leader, providing an innovative and AI-enabled product-concept- to-commercialization platform for retailers, brands and manufacturers of all sizes. We equip retail, fashion, luxury, footwear, outdoor, home and consumer goods brands with pioneering best-of-breed solutions to plan, design, develop, source, comply, buy, make, price, allocate, sell and replenish products. Our technology powers brands to streamline processes, drive efficiency and operate with confidence in an ever-changing market.
Our story is one of rapid growth, bold ideas and extraordinary opportunities. We re here to challenge the status quo-and we re looking for brilliant people who want to do the same. No matter where you are in the world, this is your chance to be part of something exceptional.
Senior Revenue Accountant/Manager
 
Position Summary
 
We are seeking a Senior Revenue Accountant/Manager to join our Accounting team at a fast-growing global software company. This role will play a critical role in ensuring accurate and compliant revenue recognition while helping scale the revenue accounting function through process improvement, automation, and AI-enabled solutions.
The Senior Revenue Accountant will own key aspects of the monthly and quarterly revenue close, serve as a technical accounting resource for complex customer arrangements under ASC 606 and IFRS 15 , and partner closely with Sales, Legal, Revenue Operations and other stakeholders throughout the quote- to-cash lifecycle.
 
This is both an operational and advisory role. The ideal candidate combines strong technical accounting judgment with a practical business mindset, is comfortable evaluating complex and non-standard deal structures, and proactively identifies opportunities to use technology, data, automation, and AI to improve the quality, speed, and scalability of revenue accounting processes.
 
Key Responsibilities
 
Revenue Accounting Technical Expertise
  • Own key components of the monthly and quarterly revenue close, ensuring accurate and timely revenue recognition, accounting, reconciliation, and reporting.
  • Evaluate executed and proposed customer contracts under ASC 606 and IFRS 15 , including complex and non-standard arrangements.
  • Perform technical accounting assessments involving standalone selling price (SSP), multiple performance obligations, contract modifications, variable consideration, material rights, early renewals, future purchase options, SLA credits, swaps, termination provisions, and other complex contract terms.
  • Prepare clear, well-supported technical accounting analyses and memos documenting significant judgments and conclusions.
  • Maintain contract review procedures and documentation to support consistent application of company revenue recognition policies.
  • Stay current on relevant U.S. GAAP, IFRS, FASB, SEC, and financial reporting developments and assess their impact on company policies and practices.
Revenue Close Financial Reporting
  • Prepare and/or review revenue-related journal entries, account reconciliations, and supporting schedules.
  • Perform monthly and quarterly reconciliations and fluctuation analyses for revenue, deferred revenue, unbilled accounts receivable, and other revenue-related accounts.
  • Investigate unusual trends, discrepancies, and accounting issues and drive timely resolution.
  • Develop and monitor relevant revenue accounting KPIs to improve visibility into process performance, data quality, and close execution.
  • Support management reporting, financial statement preparation, and ad hoc revenue analyses as required.
Systems, Automation AI
  • Manage and review revenue accounting activities within NetSuite ARM or similar revenue recognition systems, including sales order approval, revenue arrangements, allocation and schedule adjustments, order activation, and revenue schedule maintenance.
  • Proactively identify opportunities to automate manual and repetitive work across the revenue accounting and quote-to-cash lifecycle.
  • Design, prototype, implement, or help deploy AI-enabled tools, agents, and automated workflows that improve efficiency, scalability, analytical capability, and control.
  • Apply a clean-sheet mindset to existing processes, challenging legacy workflows and identifying opportunities to simplify or redesign them using generative AI, advanced automation.
  • Leverage automation to enhance areas such as contract review, reconciliations, fluctuation analysis, large-dataset analysis, audit support, and management reporting.
Cross-Functional Business Partnership
  • Partner proactively with Sales, Deal Desk, Legal, Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, FPA, Product, Engineering, and IT to evaluate the accounting implications of proposed transactions.
  • Provide accounting guidance before deal execution to help the business structure arrangements in a manner that supports commercial objectives while maintaining accounting compliance.
  • Advise on the revenue implications of new products, pricing models, go-to-market initiatives, and changes to commercial practices.
  • Translate complex accounting conclusions into clear, actionable guidance for non-accounting stakeholders.
  • Identify and resolve contract, system, or process discrepancies and escalate significant matters to revenue accounting leadership as appropriate.
  • Consider global implications of accounting conclusions and process changes and support consistent policies and practices across regions.
Controls, Audit Process Excellence
  • Maintain high-quality, audit-ready documentation supporting revenue accounting judgments, reconciliations, and controls.
  • Own or support key revenue-related internal controls and update control procedures as systems, business processes, products, and policies evolve.
  • Perform risk assessments associated with revenue process and system changes and recommend appropriate control enhancements.
  • Coordinate with internal and external auditors during interim and annual audits, including preparation and ownership of PBC schedules and responses to audit inquiries.
  • Lead or participate in high-impact revenue accounting projects and process improvement initiatives.
Qualifications
Required
  • Bachelor s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
  • CPA or equivalent preferred.
  • Approximately 5+ years of progressive accounting experience , with meaningful experience in revenue accounting; Big Four or other public accounting experience is preferred.
  • Strong technical knowledge of U.S. GAAP and ASC 606 , including demonstrated experience evaluating complex customer contracts and revenue recognition judgments.
  • Experience with SaaS, software, subscription, or other recurring revenue business models , including multi-element or multiple-performance-obligation arrangements.
  • Experience with ERP, billing, and revenue recognition systems; experience with NetSuite and NetSuite ARM is highly desirable.
  • Demonstrated ability to own revenue close activities and deliver accurate results under tight monthly and quarterly reporting deadlines.
  • Advanced Excel skills and strong analytical capabilities.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical accounting matters effectively to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong organizational skills and demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and cross-functional initiatives with limited supervision.
What Success Looks Like
The successful candidate will:
Bring strong technical judgment to complex revenue recognition matters.
  • Execute a high-quality, timely, and increasingly automated revenue close.
  • Become a trusted advisor to commercial and finance stakeholders on complex transactions and new business models.
  • Reduce manual work and improve scalability through thoughtful use of systems, automation, data, and AI.
  • Strengthen revenue accounting documentation, controls, and audit readiness as the company grows.
  • Take ownership, move with urgency, operate effectively through ambiguity, and continuously raise the standard for the revenue accounting function.

descriptionFromApi:
Software Engineer, Business Systems
Function: Business Technology Security - Business Systems
Location: Pune, India Hybrid
Reports to: Product Manager, Business Systems
Experience: 2-4 years
Short description
Build and run the integrations, pipelines, automations and internal tools that connect Mindtickles business systems - Salesforce, NetSuite, HRMS, Slack and Google Cloud. You take defined requirements and own the technical path end to end: design, build, ship, and keep it running.
About the team
Business Technology Security runs the systems, automation and security behind how Mindtickle operates. Business Systems is its build engine - the team that turns requirements from GTM, Finance, People Success, IT, Legal and Security into shipped systems: integrations, data pipelines, automations, internal tools and agents.
We are a small team. You will not be part of a traditional engineering squad with sprints and Scrum ceremonies. You will operate independently, usually owning a problem from a defined requirement through to a deployed, monitored solution - and then continuing to own it.
The role
You are the engineer on the team. When a system needs to talk to another system, when a manual process needs to become an automated one, when a tool needs to exist and doesnt - you build it.
Requirements come to you defined. The Product Manager and Business Systems Analyst own the business problem, the stakeholders, and the question of whether we should do it at all. The technical path is entirely yours - how its designed, what its built on, how its tested, how it fails safely, and how its supported once its live.
What youll own
Building - about half your time Integrations between business systems. Data pipelines. Automations that remove manual work from Finance, People Success, IT, Security and GTM. Internal tools and lightweight services. AI-backed workflows and agents where they are the right answer, and conventional code where they are not.
Running it - about a fifth of your time You inherit a set of automations already in production and become their owner. Monitoring, alerting, incident response, and the unglamorous work of making inherited systems observable and documented. Nothing you build gets handed to someone else to support.
Technical evaluation - about 15% When the team is deciding whether to build or buy, or whether a vendors API can actually do what the demo claimed, you build the prototype that answers it. Deep technical spikes, integration feasibility, and performance and security reality-checks - against a requirement the Product Manager and Analyst have already defined.
Migrations - about 15% Data migration, field mapping, cutover scripts and system replacements as we move platforms.
The shape of a typical week
Daily - Writing Python with Claude Code. Reading vendor API documentation. Wiring REST and GraphQL APIs, webhooks and event-driven flows. Debugging a sync that silently dropped records. Deploying to Cloud Run.
Weekly - Shipping an increment and demoing it. Working through requirements with the Product Manager and Analyst. Triaging what broke.
Monthly - One meaningful capability live in production, with monitoring, a runbook, and documentation good enough that someone else could pick it up.
Stack
Python Google Apps Script Google Cloud Platform (Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, Cloud Scheduler, Pub/Sub, BigQuery, Firestore, Cloud Storage, Compute Engine) REST and GraphQL APIs, webhooks, OAuth and service-account authentication Claude Code and modern AI tooling as a primary way of working Git and CI/CD
Business systems you will integrate with: Salesforce, NetSuite, HRMS, Slack, Google Workspace, and the wider SaaS estate.
What were looking for
We care about what you have built and kept alive, not the tools listed on your CV.
  • 2-4 years building software, integrations or automations in a professional environment
  • Strong Python , and real fluency with APIs - authentication, rate limits, retries, idempotency, pagination, webhooks and event-driven patterns
  • You have built integrations against SaaS APIs, not only configured them through consoles or drag-and-drop integration platforms
  • Hands-on cloud experience (GCP preferred; AWS or Azure is fine) with a working understanding of how to compose services rather than follow a tutorial
  • End-to-end ownership you can point to - a system you designed, built, shipped and then operated. Something that broke in production and you fixed it.
  • Debugging across system boundaries - when two systems disagree about the same record, you can work out why
  • Testing and verification instinct - you know your output is correct because you measured it, not because it ran without erroring
  • Fast on unfamiliar ground - you have picked up a stack you didnt know and shipped it. This matters more to us than prior exposure to any specific technology.
  • Clear written communication - design notes, runbooks, and documentation are part of the job, not an afterthought
Nice to have
  • Building AI agents, tool-use, and agentic workflows; MCP servers
  • Exposure to business systems - CRM, ERP, HRIS, ITSM - and the SaaS ecosystem around them
  • Data and pipeline work (BigQuery, ETL/ELT)

Role summary
We are looking for a Partner Integrations / Solutions Engineer who will be responsible for taking technical partnerships from initial discussion through to successful implementation.
The role involves working closely with both our internal engineering team and partner engineering teams to understand technical requirements, design integrations, resolve technical challenges, and ensure integrations are successfully launched and maintained.
This is a hands-on technical role , focused on delivering reliable integrations rather than sales or business development.

What youll own 1. Integration design and scoping
  • Run technical discovery with the partner: what their API exposes, what ours needs, where the gaps are
  • Define the data contract in both directions - what fields, what format, what frequency, what happens on failure
  • Produce the integration spec that both engineering teams build against
  • Realistic effort estimates and sequencing, so commercial teams dont promise timelines we cant hit
2. MCP and API architecture
  • Design and build out MCP server implementations for partner and product integrations
  • Own REST API and webhook design decisions on our side of the connection
  • Authentication and authorisation flows - OAuth, API keys, token lifecycle, scoping
  • Rate limits, retries, idempotency, error handling and failure modes
3. Data mapping and requirements
  • Determine exactly what data is required from each end and why
  • Field-level mapping, schema translation, and handling mismatches between the two models
  • Flag privacy, consent and compliance implications early - especially for payment and student data
  • Define what gets synced, what stays local, and who is the source of truth
4. Build, test and launch
  • Sandbox setup, test plans, UAT coordination with the partners technical team
  • Debug failing integrations - read logs, trace requests, isolate whether its us or them
  • Own the go-live checklist and post-launch monitoring
  • Version and deprecation management as partner APIs change
5. Marketplace and technical enablement
  • Get us listed on partner marketplaces and app directories, meeting their technical review requirements
  • Write and maintain integration documentation, setup guides and API reference material
  • Build demo environments and reference implementations
  • Technical enablement for the partners support and solutions teams
Must-have
  • 5-8 years in solutions engineering, partner/integration engineering, technical account management or integration consulting at a SaaS or API company
  • Hands-on: can read API documentation, hit endpoints with Postman or curl, read a log and find the problem
  • Strong grasp of REST APIs, webhooks, JSON, OAuth and common auth patterns
  • Has personally delivered at least two third-party integrations end to end - can walk through the architecture and what broke
  • Can write clearly for a technical audience - specs, docs, integration guides
  • Comfortable holding their ground in a technical conversation with a partners senior engineers
Strongly preferred
  • MCP (Model Context Protocol) experience, or a demonstrable grasp of the concept and appetite to go deep
  • Scripting ability - Python or JavaScript - enough to prototype and test
  • Payment gateway or WhatsApp Business API integration experience
  • Prior work on a marketplace listing or partner app submission
  • Exposure to AI/LLM tooling and agent architectures

Qualification
  • Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Relevant experience in API integrations, solutions engineering, partner engineering, or technical consulting is required.

jobDescription:
MSIL is looking for a QA Automation Engineer with 3-5 years of experience who is equally comfortable with manual/functional testing and automation. The role requires a clear, hands-on understanding of core manual testing concepts (test case design, functional and regression testing, exploratory and UAT testing) along with the ability to build and maintain automation frameworks for UI, API, and database validation. The candidate will work across multiple projects simultaneously, coordinate closely with development teams on a day-to-day basis, and provide constructive feedback to help improve code quality and release readiness.
 
KEY ROLES RESPONSIBILITIES
- Demonstrate a clear, working understanding of manual and functional testing concepts, including test case design techniques such as boundary value analysis and equivalence partitioning.
- Analyse business and functional requirements to prepare test scenarios, test cases, test data, and requirement traceability matrices.
- Execute functional, regression, smoke, sanity, exploratory, system, and UAT-support testing across web and API applications.
- Validate bug fixes and enhancements manually before automation coverage is built out.
- Design, develop, and maintain automation frameworks (Page Object Model, Hybrid, Data-Driven, Keyword-Driven, BDD/Cucumber) for UI, API, and integration testing.
- Automate web UI test cases using Playwright and/or Selenium WebDriver.
- Build API automation using REST Assured, Postman, or Python-based frameworks.
- Develop database and ETL validation scripts using SQL (joins, stored procedures) to compare source and target systems.
- Hands-on experience in performance and load testing using K6/JMeter, including workload design, execution analysis of response time, throughput and error rates.
- Performed security testing using OWASP Based practices and security scanning tools, supporting identification and remediation of application vulnerabilities.
- Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps) and maintain test execution reports (Allure/Extent Reports).
- Continuously identify opportunities to expand automation coverage and reduce repetitive manual testing effort.
- Manage and prioritize testing activities across multiple concurrent projects/releases, balancing timelines without compromising quality.
- Maintain strong, ongoing coordination with development teams throughout the SDLC to clarify requirements, discuss defects, and validate fixes quickly.
- Provide clear, constructive feedback to developers on defects, code quality, and testability to support faster resolution and continuous improvement.
- Collaborate with Business Analysts, Product Owners, and DevOps/SRE teams to align on quality standards and delivery timelines.
- Participate actively in sprint planning, daily stand-ups, estimation, retrospectives, and defect triage.
- Review requirements and identify suitable automation candidates in collaboration with the team.
- Perform root cause analysis on defects and track issues to closure, reporting quality metrics and test status to stakeholders.

Manual Functional Testing
Test Case Design, Boundary Value Analysis, Equivalence Partitioning, Functional / Regression / Smoke / Sanity Testing, Exploratory Testing, UAT Support
UI Automation
Playwright (Java/TypeScript)/ Selenium WebDriver - strong hands-on expertise preferred
Programming
Java or Python
API Testing
REST API, REST Assured, Postman
Database
SQL, Stored Procedures, Joins, Database Validation, ETL validation using SQL
Frameworks / Design
TestNG, JUnit, PyTest; Page Object Model, Hybrid, Data-Driven, Keyword-Driven, BDD (Cucumber)
Visual Testing
Applitools or equivalent
CI/CD Version Control
Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Git, Maven, Gradle
Test/Defect Management
JIRA, Xray, TestRail, Confluence
Cloud Basics
AWS/Azure fundamentals
Other
XPath, CSS, DOM, and network debugging; Strong performance testing exposure (JMeter/K6)
 
QUALIFICATIONS
- Bachelors degree (BE/B.Tech/M.Tech) in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical field.
- 3-5 years of hands-on experience in QA/test engineering, covering both manual and automation testing.
- Strong understanding of software testing methodologies, SDLC, and STLC.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to independently investigate and resolve technical issues.
- Working knowledge of Windows and Linux environments.
- Proven ability to manage multiple projects/priorities at the same time in a fast-paced environment.
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to work in Agile, cross-functional, and globally distributed teams.
PREFERRED / GOOD TO HAVE
- Experience with Docker and Kubernetes basics.
- Exposure to AI-assisted testing tools and techniques.
- Familiarity with microservices, event-driven architecture, and messaging systems (Kafka/RabbitMQ basics).
- Awareness of security testing practices.
- Experience with Agile/Waterfall project tracking tools (JIRA, qTest, Trello).
- ISTQB Foundation Level certification.
 
KEY BEHAVIORAL COMPETENCIES
- Strong coordination and communication skills to work closely with development, product, and business teams on a daily basis.
- Ability to give clear, constructive, and actionable feedback to developers in a collaborative, non-confrontational manner.
- Comfortable managing and switching context across multiple projects/releases without losing attention to detail.
- Ownership mindset with a proactive approach to identifying quality risks early in the SDLC.
- Adaptable and willing to learn new tools, domains, and testing approaches quickly.

Job Summary
Associate Customer Engineer Onboarding Specialist is the frontline technical owner of the customer onboarding journey. You are the hands-on engine that turns a provisioned account into a live, value-generating deployment. Working within the GTM organization and reporting to a Customer Engineering Leader, you will run structured onboarding engagements, guide customers to configure foundational settings, validate traffic behavior, and deliver standard guidance that accelerates customers to first value. You are not quota-carrying; your success is measured by onboarding velocity, time-to-value, customer satisfaction, and seamless hand-off to post-onboarding teams. You will spend your time executing approved runbooks, troubleshooting common issues, documenting everything with rigor, and collaborating with CEs, AEs, and Support to ensure no customer falls through the cracks.


Key Responsibilities
  • Onboarding Execution Technical Enablement: Own the end-to-end technical onboarding experience for assigned customers post-provision. Lead structured onboarding calls, guide customers to configure initial Cloudflare settings (e. g. , DNS records, SSL/TLS modes, WAF rules, Zero Trust policies), and validate that traffic is behaving as expected before the customer is declared live. Guide customers through approved implementation runbooks with precision, and exercise judgment to identify when an engagement has outgrown the runbook and requires escalation to a Customer Engineer, Support, or Professional Services. Troubleshoot common onboarding issues including DNS resolution failures, SSL/TLS certificate errors, caching misconfigurations, and authentication failures. Ensure every onboarding reaches a clean, documented close with the customer able to operate independently on the Cloudflare platform.
  • Customer Guidance Communication: Deliver standardized customer guidance sessions that walk customers through the Cloudflare dashboard, DNS change procedures, SSL/TLS configuration, and product-specific best practices. Translate complex technical concepts into plain language that non-technical stakeholders can act on, and maintain a calm, patient presence when customers are frustrated or behind schedule. Set clear agendas for every call, provide concise written summaries, and document next steps so that customers and internal teams always know who owns what.
  • Process Operational Excellence: Maintain impeccable documentation hygiene across all customer engagements using Ai supported tools. Update CRM/Salesforce records after every touchpoint, produce call follow-ups and action-item lists, and track milestones within onboarding projects to ensure no step is skipped and no deadline is missed. Juggle a portfolio of concurrent onboarding customers with strong time management, prioritizing by committed timelines and customer urgency. Flag blockers early, manage expectations proactively, and treat the onboarding pipeline as a system you continuously optimize.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration Escalation Management: Act as the customer s voice inside Cloudflare during onboarding. Surface expansion opportunities (new products, additional seats, higher tiers) to CEs and AEs with enough context for them to act. Route complex technical issues, architectural questions, and break/fix escalations to the appropriate Support or Customer Engineering teams with clear, complete background documentation. Partner smoothly with adjacent teams without letting the customer feel handed off; you are the single point of accountability until onboarding is complete.
  • Technical Breadth Continuous Development: Build and maintain working knowledge across Cloudflare s product foundations Application Security, CDN, Zero Trust/SASE, and Network Services at a depth appropriate to onboarding scenarios. Be familiar with and leverage AI technology available to you to create new and innovative tools to support and increase your onboarding activities. Stay current on Cloudflare product releases, feature roadmaps, and relevant certifications. Invest in expanding your technical foundation over time, treating each onboarding as a learning opportunity and engaging feedback from peers and leaders to improve with every customer


Mandatory Skills
  • Cloudflare product foundations: working knowledge of Application Security, CDN, Zero Trust/SASE, and Network Services.
  • Networking fundamentals: understanding of DNS, TLS/SSL, HTTP/HTTPS, CIDR, NAT, and BGP.
  • Web security basics: familiarity with OWASP, WAF rules, OAuth, SAML, MFA, and Zero Trust principles.
  • Configuration integration: hands-on experience with the Cloudflare Dashboard, and comfort with Terraform, API-based configurations, or identity providers such as Okta, Azure AD, and SAML/OIDC integrations.
  • Observability: ability to read and interpret Security Events, Logs, cURL outputs, and HAR files; awareness of common causes of 5xx/4xx errors post-onboarding.

Good-to-Have Skills

jobDescription:
Role Overview
We are seeking an HR Applications Administrator to join our Business Technology / Enterprise Applications team, responsible for administering, configuring, and supporting the applications behind Five9's HR, Payroll, and Talent programs, primarily UKG (formerly UltiPro), with additional support for Deel, Greenhouse, and various other HR applications. This role partners closely with Human Resources, Payroll, Finance, Business Technology, InfoSec, and external vendors to keep our HR systems secure, reliable, and effective.
The ideal candidate has hands-on UKG administration experience, along with a UKG Pro certification, strongly preferred. Candidates with substantial Workday administration experience and a Workday certification may also be a strong fit. This person communicates clearly, partners well across HR, Payroll, Finance, Business Technology, InfoSec, and vendor teams, and manages day-to-day administration independently.
The position is a hybrid role combining in-office and work-from-home days, based in Chennai or Bengaluru, India, and requires regular overlap with United States business hours, including work until approximately 11:30 PM India Standard Time when needed.


Key Responsibilities
  • Administer and configure Five9's HR applications on a day-to-day basis, with primary focus on UKG Pro (formerly UltiPro), including system settings, business rules, and module configuration.
  • Maintain system security roles, permissions, and access controls across HR applications to ensure appropriate data protection and compliance with company policy.
  • Build, test, and maintain business process workflows, approval chains, and notifications within UKG Pro and related HR systems.
  • Support and maintain integrations between UKG Pro, Deel, Greenhouse, Degreed Learning Experience Platform, Replicon, and other business applications, partnering with Business Technology teams as needed.
  • Perform system testing, including validation of configuration changes, patches, and vendor releases prior to production deployment.
  • Coordinate periodic vendor releases and platform updates, assessing impact to existing configuration and coordinating regression testing with stakeholders.
  • Monitor data quality across HR systems, and identify, troubleshoot, and resolve data integrity issues.
  • Build and maintain reports and dashboards to support HR, Payroll, and business stakeholder reporting needs.
  • Maintain clear, current documentation of system configurations, processes, and support procedures.
  • Provide day-to-day user support and troubleshooting for HR application end users, resolving issues in a timely manner.
  • Manage vendor relationships for supported HR applications, including support tickets, escalations, and roadmap discussions.
  • Support the AI Center of Excellence by identifying and helping implement opportunities to leverage AI to automate hire-to-retire and payroll-related processes.
  • Partner with Human Resources, Payroll, Finance, Business Technology, and InfoSec teams to gather requirements and implement solutions that meet business needs.


Required Qualifications
  • A minimum of 5 years of experience administering enterprise Human Resources applications, with hands-on UKG Pro (formerly UltiPro) experience as the primary qualification.
  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience managing security roles, permissions, and access controls within an HRIS platform.
  • Experience building and maintaining business process workflows, approval chains, and notifications.
  • Experience supporting integrations between HR systems and other enterprise applications.
  • Experience with system testing, including validating configuration changes and vendor releases prior to production deployment.
  • Experience monitoring and maintaining data quality and data integrity across HR systems.
  • Experience building reports and dashboards to support HR and business reporting needs.
  • Strong documentation skills, with the ability to maintain clear and current process and configuration documentation.
  • Experience providing end-user support and troubleshooting for HR applications.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to partner effectively with Human Resources, Payroll, Finance, Business Technology, InfoSec, and external vendors.
  • Experience managing vendor relationships, including support escalations and coordination on releases.


Preferred Qualifications
  • UKG Pro certification (strongly preferred).
  • Workday certification, for candidates whose primary HRIS administration experience is with Workday.
  • Deel certification preferred.
  • Experience with Greenhouse, Degreed Learning Experience Platform, or Replicon desired.
  • Experience administering another major Human Resources Information System, supported by relevant qualifications or certifications.


Why You'll Love This Role
  • You will play a key role in supporting and evolving the technology that powers Five9's HR, Payroll, and Talent programs.
  • You will work hands-on with UKG Pro and gain exposure to a broader ecosystem of leading HR platforms.
  • You will use cutting-edge technologies, including AI, to help create great employee experiences.
  • You will build strong partnerships across Human Resources, Payroll, Finance, Business Technology, InfoSec, and vendor teams.
  • If you enjoy solving practical problems, safeguarding data quality, and delivering excellent support to HR technology users, this role offers strong opportunities to grow your HRIS expertise.
Note: Five9 will never request that an applicant send money as a prerequisite for commencing employment with Five9.

Yext is seeking a Staff Accountant to join its growing and dynamic International Accounting team. This is a hands-on position with a mix of accounting and operational duties. This role will primarily focus on intercompany accounting and payroll accounting for a group of entities, assisting in the day to day transaction processing and accounting, preparing account reconciliations in connection with the close process, and supporting the Senior and Lead Accountants with day-to-day workload.   • Preparing reconciliations and roll forwards, account analysis and processing month end journal entries for a variety of G/L accounts
  • Support and assist with the monthly, quarterly, and annual financial close processes
  • Assist in preparing schedules and supporting documentation for statutory financial statements
  • Support Senior and Lead Accountants with day-to-day workload and provide ad-hoc analysis when requested
  • Assist in maintaining and tracking the audit query tracker for Yext international entities.
  • Support the audit by extracting the underlying documentation and preparing adhoc reports
  • Manage, analyze, and reconcile large volumes of data in Excel from various internal systems and the general ledger
  • Support process improvement initiatives focusing on enhancing accounting processes, systems, and related internal controls


What You Have
  • 2+ years of post-qualification experience
  • Working understanding of GAAP (Generally accepted Accounting principles) and accounting concepts
  • Ability to manipulate and manage large amounts of data
  • Collaborative style with the ability to communicate clearly and precisely on operational issues and cross functional collaboration
  • Must be detail and results-oriented with an ability to work in a cross-functional, fast-paced, and constantly evolving environment
  • Excellent written and formal presentation skills
  • Proficient in the Microsoft Office Suite, including MS Excel, Word and Powerpoint
  • Prior experience working in an international business environment


Bonus Points
  • Qualified CA (Chartered Accountant) or equivalent degree in Accounting
  • Prior experience with intercompany accounting and/or payroll accounting, ideally in a multinational, GCC, or shared services environment
  • Familiarity with NetSuite or similar ERP/GL systems

ProCreator is looking for an HR Generalist / People Operations professional to own and drive core HR operations across the employee lifecycle, while helping strengthen people processes, employee experience, policy governance, and hiring coordination.
This role is ideal for someone who is hands-on, process-oriented, and comfortable managing day-to-day HR operations independently. The person will play a key role in ensuring smooth onboarding, employee record management, attendance and leave administration, payroll inputs, engagement initiatives, policy execution, and exit formalities. Alongside this, the role will also support recruitment governance and collaborate closely with the recruiter and hiring stakeholders to ensure process adherence and business continuity.
While the role is primarily an individual contributor position, the person may oversee one recruiter and is expected to step into hiring execution when recruitment volumes or business priorities demand it.

Key Responsibilities
1) Core HR Operations
  • Own end-to-end employee lifecycle administration from post-offer handover through onboarding, active employment, and exits
  • Manage employee records, letters, workflows, approvals, and documentation through HR systems, especially Zoho People
  • Handle joining formalities including employment documents, NDA, code of conduct, KYC, bank details, background verification coordination, and induction readiness
  • Coordinate with internal stakeholders such as IT for asset allocation, ID creation, access setup, RFID cards, and other onboarding requirements
  • Administer leave, attendance, holiday calendars, attendance regularizations, special leave creation, and exception handling
  • Provide accurate monthly payroll inputs to the Accounts team and support resolution of employee queries related to attendance, leave, payroll inputs, and employee records
  • Maintain HR documentation required for audits, compliance, and insurance-related processes

    2) People Processes and Employee Experience
    • Drive probation confirmations, salary revision documentation, promotions, role changes, and related employee lifecycle actions
    • Act as a reliable first point of contact for employee queries related to HR policies, insurance, documentation, and routine employment matters
    • Plan and coordinate employee engagement initiatives including birthdays, work anniversaries, festive celebrations, team activities, culture-building efforts, and internal learning sessions
    • Support employee well-being initiatives, feedback surveys, POSH-related coordination, and periodic learning and development facilitation
    • Ensure a smooth, professional, and employee-friendly HR experience across key people touchpoints

      3) Employee Relations and Governance
      • Support managers on policy interpretation, employee discipline matters, notice period discussions, underperformance cases, and other sensitive people issues, escalating when necessary
      • Maintain and update employee handbook, leave policy, code of conduct, and day-to-day HR process documentation
      • Help strengthen governance by ensuring HR processes are followed consistently and documentation is maintained accurately
      • Own HR workflow updates, template changes, automation requests, and coordination with system partners for issue resolution

        4) Recruitment Coordination and Business Support
        • Provide recruitment governance support by coordinating hiring intake, role approvals, interview process adherence, and hiring progress tracking with stakeholders
        • Partner with the recruiter and hiring managers on offer approvals, parity checks, onboarding readiness, and seamless handover from recruitment to people operations
        • Support hiring execution directly during peak hiring periods or when business needs require additional recruitment bandwidth
        • Ensure recruitment ownership is approached with flexibility and collaboration, rather than as a rigidly separated function



          Requirements
          Must-Have Skills and Experience
          • 45 years of relevant experience in HR operations, people operations, or HR generalist roles
          • Strong hands-on experience managing the employee lifecycle from onboarding to exit
          • Working knowledge of HRMS platforms , preferably Zoho People
          • Solid experience in onboarding, HR documentation, leave and attendance management, payroll input coordination, and employee records management
          • Ability to independently handle employee queries and routine people operations matters in a timely and professional manner
          • Good understanding of HR policies, process documentation, compliance coordination, and governance practices
          • Experience supporting employee engagement initiatives and people experience programs
          • Strong coordination skills, with the ability to work cross-functionally with recruiters, managers, Accounts, IT, and leadership
          • Willingness to support recruitment execution when required by business demand
          • Strong ownership mindset, attention to detail, process discipline, and comfort working in a fast-paced environment

            Preferred Skills / Nice to Have
            • Proficiency in Zoho People and Zoho Recruit for HR operations and recruitment coordination
            • Ability to make backend changes, workflow updates, and system-level process improvements in Zoho tools
            • Experience creating, streamlining, and scaling HR processes for operational efficiency
            • Tech-savvy mindset with interest in AI adoption in HR , including automation, analytics, chatbots, and AI-enabled hiring tools
            • Awareness of evolving HR technology trends and the ability to suggest process or system improvements
            • Prior experience working in UX/UI, development, branding, creative, or marketing agency environments will be preferred for stronger business and cultural fit

              Education
              • Bachelor degree in any discipline
              • Relevant work experience and practical HR capability will be valued more than academic specialization

                What Success Looks Like in the First 90 Days
                By the end of the first 90 days, success in this role would look like:
                • You have taken ownership of day-to-day HR operations and are independently managing core employee lifecycle processes with minimal supervision
                • Employee records, onboarding documentation, leave and attendance tracking, and routine HR workflows are well organized and running smoothly in Zoho People
                • Payroll inputs are being shared accurately and on time, with fewer follow-ups or errors
                • New joiner onboarding is structured, timely, and well-coordinated across HR, IT, and other stakeholders
                • Employee queries are being responded to promptly and professionally, creating a dependable HR support experience
                • Key HR documents, templates, and policy/process trackers are updated, easy to access, and better organized than before
                • At least a few process improvement opportunities have been identified and implemented across HR operations, workflows, or system usage
                • Employee engagement and people experience initiatives are being run consistently with strong coordination and follow-through
                • Recruitment governance is running smoothly, with proper coordination between hiring managers, recruiter, and internal stakeholders
                • During high hiring periods, you are able to step in and support recruitment execution without losing grip on core HR operations
                • You have built trust with employees, managers, the recruiter, and the COO as a reliable owner of people operations

                  Who You Are
                  • Hands-on and dependable, with a strong bias for execution
                  • Comfortable balancing structure, empathy, and responsiveness in day-to-day HR work
                  • Process-minded, organized, and able to manage multiple moving parts without losing detail
                  • Collaborative and practical in approach, with the confidence to work closely with managers and leadership
                  • Adaptable enough to support both people operations and hiring priorities as needed



                    Benefits
                    This role offers the opportunity to build meaningful impact across people operations in a growing business environment. You will help shape core HR processes, improve employee experience, support managers and teams, and bring structure and consistency to the people function while partnering closely with leadership.
                    At ProCreator, were not just offering a job; were providing a platform for you to thrive, grow, and lead. Here what makes us unique:
                    Unmatched Growth Opportunities :
                    • Wealth-Building Benefits : ESOPs, Shared Appreciation Rights (SAR), profit-sharing, and referral bonuses to recognize your contributions.
                    • Skill Development : Access professional growth funds, learning courses, and mentorship programs tailored to your ambitions.
                      A Work Environment That Inspires:
                      • Comfort Redefined: Ergonomic furniture, standing desks, and training for optimal productivity and well-being.
                      • Flexibility : We offer the flexibility of working from the office as well as hybrid work arrangements.
                        Health and Wellness Focus

Corporate Title: Assistant Vice President
Location: Pune, India
Role Description
  • This position sits within Deutsche Banks eDiscovery and Archiving Technology group and will play a leading engineering role in the modernization of a critical enterprise data platform. The platform provides identification, data-source intelligence, and configuration-control capabilities supporting defensible eDiscovery decisions across Legal, Compliance, HR, Audit, and Investigations. The successful candidate will strengthen and evolve the existing on-premise data platform while leading the technical design and hands-on development of a new generation GCP-based data platform. This is a deeply hands-on engineering role, not a pure architecture, coordination, or people-management position. It requires expert-level Java engineering, strong data-platform design capability, practical Python coding knowledge, and the ability to convert complex legacy business logic into modular, testable, observable, and auditable services and data products. The role will set engineering direction, lead designs, influence technical team members through code-level credibility, and remain directly accountable for coding, code reviews, debugging, troubleshooting, and production delivery.

  • Best in class leave policy.
  • Gender neutral parental leaves
  • 100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender neutral)
  • Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education
  • Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members
  • Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents
  • Accident and Term life Insurance
  • Complementary Health screening for 35 yrs. and above
