We are looking for a Technical Recruiter to own end-to-end hiring execution for ProCreator, with a strong focus on creative and technical roles across UI/UX Design, Graphics/Visual design, Product Design, and Frontend/Backend development .
This role is ideal for someone who can independently drive recruitment from role intake through offer closure and pre-joining engagement, while partnering closely with hiring managers, HR, and leadership. The recruiter will be responsible not just for execution, but also for improving hiring workflows, maintaining strong candidate experience, and contributing to more efficient, insight-led recruitment operations.
The ideal candidate brings hands-on experience hiring for agency-style and technical environments, understands the nuances of assessing both creative and technical talent, and is comfortable using modern tools and AI-enabled workflows to improve hiring quality and speed.

Key Responsibilities
Talent Acquisition Execution
  • Own end-to-end recruitment for design and technology roles, especially across UI/UX, visual design, product design, and front-end developer hiring.
  • Partner with hiring managers to understand role requirements and create or refine job descriptions, candidate assessments, hiring tasks, and interview questions.
  • Publish and manage open roles across ATS platforms, LinkedIn, job boards, social channels, and relevant sourcing platforms.
  • Drive proactive sourcing, outreach, screening, and shortlisting of candidates aligned to role requirements and agency-specific expectations.
  • Conduct recruiter screening conversations to assess candidate fit across experience, role relevance, communication, motivations, and compensation expectations.
  • Manage candidate pipelines and ensure timely movement of qualified candidates through each stage of the process.
  • Coordinate assessments, collect submissions, share them with hiring teams, and drive follow-through on interview stages.
    Stakeholder and Candidate Management
    • Schedule and coordinate interviews across stakeholders while ensuring a smooth and timely process.
    • Gather structured interview feedback and keep hiring managers aligned on candidate status, risks, and next steps.
    • Deliver a strong candidate experience through clear communication, expectation setting, and timely closure at every stage.
    • Support offer discussions, compensation alignment, document collection, and candidate negotiation in partnership with HR and leadership.
    • Maintain pre-joining engagement with selected candidates to reduce drop-offs and ensure smooth transition until joining.
      Recruitment Operations and Talent Strategy
      • Build and maintain talent pipelines and market maps for recurring or hard-to-fill roles.
      • Work with external agencies, campus partners, and niche talent sources when required.
      • Maintain ATS hygiene and ensure accurate candidate records, stage tracking, notes, and follow-ups across all active roles.
      • Track recruitment metrics such as source effectiveness, funnel conversion, aging positions, and closure timelines, and share insights with relevant stakeholders.
      • Contribute to employer branding from a hiring lens through candidate-facing communication, hiring-related content, and brand perception across recruitment platforms.
      • Document and improve recruitment workflows, interview scorecards, candidate communication templates, and best practices to support operational efficiency and scale.



        Requirements

        Must-Have Skills and Experience
        • 45 years of relevant recruitment experience in an in-house, agency, digital, product studio, or tech/services hiring environment .
        • Strong experience hiring for technical and creative roles , especially in areas such as UI/UX, visual design, product design, and front-end development .
        • Ability to independently manage the full recruitment lifecycle from intake to offer closure and pre-joining engagement.
        • Strong sourcing and outreach capability across multiple channels and platforms.
        • Experience partnering with hiring managers to define role requirements and improve hiring quality.
        • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to drive alignment and momentum across hiring teams.
        • Experience managing ATS workflows and maintaining strong process discipline and candidate tracking hygiene.
        • Experience coordinating interviews, managing assessments, and ensuring a smooth candidate journey.
        • Ability to evaluate candidates on role relevance, functional capability, communication, and compensation fit.
        • Experience supporting offer management and negotiation in coordination with HR and business leaders.
        • Strong attention to detail, ownership mindset, and ability to manage multiple open roles simultaneously.
          Preferred / Bonus Skills
          • Experience working with Zoho Recruit ATS .
          • Experience creating, streamlining, and scaling recruitment processes for better operational efficiency.
          • Prior hiring exposure in a UX/UI agency , digital agency, product studio, or similar fast-paced creative-tech environment.
          • Tech-savvy mindset with interest in AI adoption within recruitment , including automation, analytics, chatbots, and AI-enabled hiring tools.
          • Awareness of evolving recruitment technology trends and the ability to suggest process, workflow, or system improvements.
            Educational Qualification
            • Bachelor degree in any discipline is acceptable.
            • Relevant prior recruitment experience will be valued more strongly than academic specialization.
              What Success Looks Like in 90 Days
              • Takes confident ownership of active hiring mandates across design and technical roles with minimal handholding.
              • Builds strong working relationships with hiring managers and establishes credibility through responsiveness, judgment, and process ownership.
              • Maintains clean and reliable ATS data, clear pipeline visibility, and disciplined follow-ups across open roles.
              • Improves quality and speed of shortlisting through stronger sourcing, screening, and role understanding.
              • Creates a smoother and more professional candidate experience across scheduling, communication, and closure.
              • Brings structure to assessments, interview coordination, and feedback collection.
              • Begins identifying practical opportunities to improve hiring workflows, reduce delays, and strengthen recruitment operations.




                Benefits Benefits
                At ProCreator, were not just offering a job; were providing a platform for you to thrive, grow, and lead. Here what makes us unique:
                Unmatched Growth Opportunities :
                • Wealth-Building Benefits : ESOPs, Shared Appreciation Rights (SAR), profit-sharing, and referral bonuses to recognize your contributions.
                • Skill Development : Access professional growth funds, learning courses, and mentorship programs tailored to your ambitions.
                  A Work Environment That Inspires:
                  • Comfort Redefined: Ergonomic furniture, standing desks, and training for optimal productivity and well-being.
                  • Flexibility : We offer the flexibility of working from the office as well as hybrid work arrangements.
                    Health and Wellness Focus :
                    • Comprehensive Health Coverage : Insurance up to INR 5,00,000.
                    • Team Bonding Retreats: Strengthen connections and recharge during annual team-building getaways.

North Star: to empower teams to focus on delivering business value, by creating a zero-touch, secure, reliable, and cutting-edge technology platform capable of orchestrating full build and production deployment processes.
The group is organized into small, autonomous squads. Release Engineers work across the full software delivery lifecycle - from CI/CD and containerization to cloud infrastructure and release governance - and act as a trusted point of support for engineering teams across the company via the groups dedicated support channels.
This is a hybrid role: part software engineer, part cloud/infrastructure engineer, and part release governance owner. Expectations scale with seniority - from being autonomous in your own work, to leveraging your knowledge to help the team hit its goals, to guiding others and balancing technical, business, and operational needs.
Key Responsibilities
- CI/CD ownership: Build, maintain, and improve CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps Pipelines and GitHub Actions workflows) that power build, test, and deployment automation across OutSystems services.
- Container image management: Maintain and secure the Docker base-image catalogue (ingestion, versioning, deprecation, scanning) and manage AMI/machine-image pipelines (Packer, EC2 Image Builder) for build and CI infrastructure.
- Cloud infrastructure: Manage and provision cloud resources across AWS (ECR, EC2, IAM/OIDC) and Azure (ACR, Azure DevOps), using Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform via Spacelift).
- Versioning packaging: Own semantic versioning and package management practices (GitVersion, SemVer, NuGet feeds) to keep releases consistent and traceable.
- Release governance: Operate release governance processes, including RFC/CAB change management, deployment gating, and rollback procedures for production changes.
- Operational support: Staff the Release Engineering support rotation, triaging and resolving developer requests and incidents raised through dedicated support channels.
- Monitoring metrics: Build and maintain observability into pipelines and deployments using tools such as Grafana, Power BI, and Kibana.
- Security compliance: Uphold security and compliance standards (SOC 2 and FedRAMP controls, vulnerability scanning via Wiz/Snyk) across the release pipeline.
- Leadership enablement: As seniority grows, guide other engineers, mentor teams adopting CI platform/release best practices, and represent Release Engineerings roadmap to stakeholders across the company.
Skills You Need to Succeed
Skills below are ranked by how central they are to day-to-day Release Engineering work. Must-haves are used constantly and span nearly every squad; good-to-haves add significant value but are more specialized or team-specific and can often be developed on the job.
MUST HAVES:
  • CI/CD pipelines: Azure DevOps Pipelines and GitHub Actions - designing, debugging, and maintaining build/release workflows.
  • OCI Lifecycle: Development and management of the full life cycle of OCI artifacts.
  • Cloud platform fundamentals: AWS (ECR, IAM/OIDC, EC2, RDS) and Azure (ACR,Azure Machines and DBs, Azure DevOps) core services.
  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC) Image Building: Proficiency in Terraform, CloudFormation for cloud provisioning and experience with Packer and EC2 Image Builder are must-have skills.
  • Ownership under pressure: A strong sense of urgency, customer focus, and reliability as a support point for other engineering teams.
GOOD TO HAVES:
  • Git workflows semantic versioning: Branching strategies, tagging, GitVersion/SemVer discipline, and NuGet/npm feed mechanics.
  • Observability monitoring: Hands-on experience designing, building, and managing end-to-end monitoring and alerting systems to gain operational insights across pipelines and platform components (e.g., using tools like Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, Power BI, or Kibana).
  • Security vulnerability scanning: Working knowledge of security practices, vulnerability scanning, and compliance standards such as SOC 2 and FedRAMP.
  • Release change governance: RFC/CAB processes and staged (ring-based) promotion models for production changes.
  • GitOps Kubernetes: Flux-based GitOps repositories and Helm release troubleshooting across multiple environment rings.
  • Cross-team mentoring leadership: Experience mentoring other engineers or representing a teams roadmap to stakeholders

Job Description
About MACA: Analytics and Strategic Consulting for Hospital Leaders
Market Access Custom Analytics (MACA) is Intuitive s healthcare analytics and strategic consulting function, partnering with hospital leaders to solve complex strategic questions using clinical, operational, financial, and market data. We combine advanced analytics, healthcare economics, and structured problem solving to generate actionable insights that support executive decision-making, improve performance, expand patient access, and drive sustainable growth
Position Overview:
We are seeking an Associate to join the India MACA team. This role is ideal for an analytical professional who can structure ambiguous healthcare problems, work with complex datasets and collaborate effectively with internal external stakeholders to translate analysis into practical insights that support hospital strategy, access, growth, and performance improvement
Roles and Responsibilities:
  • Analytics Insight Generation: Lead analytics workstreams for MACA engagements with hospitals, translating clinical, operational, financial, and market data into clear executive insights
  • Structured Problem Solving: Define problem statements, build business cases, and identify opportunities to improve growth, access, productivity, and value
  • Data Intelligence: Integrate data from multiple sources to create compelling diagnostics, narratives and recommendations that support planning and performance
  • Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner closely with internal commercial, enabling, clinical, marketing, and leadership teams, as well as external hospital stakeholders, to align priorities, shape analytics questions, and translate insights into practical engagement plans
  • Outcome Translation: Convert analysis into measurable outcomes by defining practical actions, impact metrics, and follow-through mechanisms for stakeholders
  • Asset Creation: Develop scalable analytics assets, repeatable methodologies, and digital tools that strengthen MACA s customer-facing consulting work in collaboration with Commercial Enabling functions
  • AI Innovation: Apply emerging analytics and AI-enabled approaches to improve speed, quality, and scalability of insight generation
Desired :

  • Experience working with healthcare, hospital, payer, provider, or life sciences data
Technical Skill Set
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and at least one analytics platform or language such as Python, R, Power BI, or SQL
  • Experience extracting data, building analytical workflows, and visualizing insights using tools such as Snowflake and Tableau preferred

  • Ability to derive insights, not just report metrics; simplify complexity

  • Self-starter with a high degree of ownership and bias for action
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Comfort working with ambiguity and open-ended business questions

  • MBA or Master s degree preferred

  • Clarify requirements and ensure development teams understand the desired product outcomes.

  • Validate that delivered functionality meets acceptance criteria and business objectives.
  • Support product releases including documentation, training, and internal enablement.
  • Collaborate with product management and leadership on roadmap execution.

  • Work with implementation, support, and sales teams to ensure product features align with customer needs.
  • Provide product expertise for internal stakeholders.
  • Help drive continuous improvement of scheduling capabilities.

  • Experience working in Agile / Scrum development environments.
  • Experience with ERP systems.

  • Ability to translate business requirements into technical product specifications.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Product backlog management
  • Agile / Scrum development
  • Scheduling / manufacturing operations
  • Requirements definition
  • Stakeholder communication
  • Data-driven decision making

  • Experience with tools such as Jira or similar backlog management systems.

At Amtech, you will drive meaningful financial impact in a growing enterprise software organization while benefiting from Vista s world-class ecosystem. This role partners closely with Cyber and IT Engineering/Operations teams across each area of the data center, cloud, compute, storage, network, and virtualization to identify risk and drive adoption of stronger technical controls

  • Partner with Cyber and IT Engineering/Operations teams spanning compute, storage, network, and virtualization in the data center and cloud environment, as well as the M365/Exchange Online team, to drive cyber security best practices.
  • Maintain working knowledge of the tools and systems used to manage and protect data center and cloud infrastructure (hardening standards, patch and vulnerability management, privileged access, configuration management, cloud security posture tooling) and administer/tune the Proofpoint email security platform.
  • Design and recommend email security architecture and technical controls that reduce phishing, business email compromise, and account takeover risk.
  • Identify and help drive remediation on gaps in baseline security controls across data center, cloud, and email environments, working with system owners to prioritize based on risk.
  • Act as a technical liaison between Security/SecOps and IT Infrastructure, Operations, and Exchange teams, translating security requirements into practical, operationally feasible controls.
  • Work with the SOC as needed to support investigation and response for infrastructure- and email-related security incidents, providing technical context on affected systems.
  • Contribute to metrics and reporting on infrastructure and email security posture, control effectiveness, and residual risk.

  • Hands-on experience administering and managing servers running Microsoft Windows and Linux operating systems with focus on cyber security hardening and best practices
  • Working knowledge of virtualization platforms (e. g. , VMware vSphere, Microsoft Hyper-V).

  • Experience with cloud IaaS/PaaS environments (AWS, Azure, and/or GCP) compute, storage, networking, and identity/access management services.

  • Knowledge of Microsoft 365, with deep focus on Exchange Online (mail flow, transport rules, connectors, authentication protocols).
  • Solid working familiarity of core email authentication standards (SPF, DKIM, DMARC)
  • Practical understanding of identity infrastructure (Active Directory, Azure AD/Entra ID) and privileged access management (PAM) concepts.

  • Understanding a variety of disruptive technology products and services

- Accountable for adherence to Toll Gate Methodology and all appropriate Global release processes
- Responsible to implement new AI-powered solutions as per the architecture designed by the GSO, enterprise architects and solution architects, ensuring that new solutions are cost optimized and easy to maintain

- Provides project planning and estimates to develop, implement and roll out pilot and commercialized AI and Customer Care solutions in OTC
- Ensure adoption of globally harmonized processes, ways of working, and strategic AI solutions within the Customer Care and OTC space

- Sales Distribution, Order to Cash process experience with a focus on Customer Care and case management
- Experience designing or delivering AI/ML or Generative AI solutions (e.g., intelligent automation, NLP, agentic workflows)

- Good knowledge of sales and distributions of fast-moving retail business processes and related technology solutions

- Good understanding of OTC tools, architecture, functions and features - including AI orchestration frameworks (e.g., AWS Agent Core)

Alation is pioneering the next era of data intelligence - powered by AI agents and trusted data. Organizations around the world rely on Alation to drive self-service analytics, cloud transformation, data governance, and AI innovation. Our technology helps enterprises connect people and data to make faster, smarter, and more confident decisions. With more than $340M in funding - valued at over $1.7 billion and more than 650 customers, including 40% of the Fortune 100.
As data becomes the foundation of every business, Alation is leading the way in helping organizations unlock their full potential. By bringing intelligence, automation, and trust to every interaction, we empower customers to scale data-driven innovation with confidence and speed.
Joining Alation means being part of a winning team shaping the future of AI-powered data intelligence. We move fast, think big, and deliver results together.
About Alation
Alation is the creator of AIOS - the intelligence operating system for enterprises that cannot afford to get AI wrong. When software breaks, it throws an error. When an AI agent breaks, it produces a confident, wrong answer - and most organizations have no system to catch it before that answer drives a decision. AIOS keeps data, context, and agents in sync in one open, governed, self-improving system, so every decision an agent makes holds up.
Having pioneered the data catalog market, Alation is trusted by over 600 enterprises worldwide - including 40% of the Fortune 500 - to power their most critical data and AI initiatives. The problems we tackle are complex, high-impact, and deeply technical. This is not a slow-moving environment. We build fast, ship real things, learn from customers, and iterate relentlessly.
About the Role
AIOS doesnt work without connectivity. Agents fail when bad data reaches them, when context is stale, or when the environment shifts underneath them - and the defense against all three starts with rich, current metadata flowing in from the systems where enterprise data actually lives. This is a leadership role for someone who can own the paid media and ABM motion end-to-end - strategy, execution quality, client relationships and outcomes. Youll be the strategic lead on a book of high-value SaaS accounts, orchestrating full-funnel LinkedIn and ABM programs alongside search and paid social, while raising the delivery bar for the specialists around you.

jobDescription:
Role Purpose
The Application Development Senior Analyst designs, builds, tests and supports secure, reliable digital solutions that meet business and customer needs. Working within an Agile delivery team, the role provides hands-on development expertise, takes ownership of moderately complex work, contributes to technical decisions and helps improve engineering quality, delivery flow and operational resilience.
Key Responsibilities
  • Analyse user stories and technical requirements, identify dependencies and translate them into maintainable solution designs.
  • Develop, configure, test and document application features using approved engineering standards, patterns and platforms.
  • Own assigned work from refinement through deployment and early-life support, providing clear progress, risk and dependency updates.
  • Produce clean, reusable and secure code or configuration, with appropriate unit tests and evidence of quality.
  • Participate actively in peer reviews and respond constructively to feedback; support less-experienced developers through knowledge sharing and practical guidance.
  • Collaborate with Product Owners, Business Analysts, Quality Engineering, Architecture, Security, Platform and Production Support colleagues.
  • Use source control and CI/CD practices effectively, supporting automated quality gates and reliable, traceable releases.
  • Troubleshoot defects and production issues using logs, monitoring and diagnostic tools; contribute to root-cause analysis and preventive actions.
  • Create and maintain concise technical documentation, including solution notes, support guidance and operational runbooks.
  • Contribute to sprint planning, refinement, daily stand-ups, reviews and retrospectives, and act on agreed continuous-improvement actions.
  • Protect customer and company data by following privacy, security, access-control and change-management requirements.
  • Keep skills current and apply relevant new capabilities where they improve quality, efficiency, reliability or customer outcomes.
Required Experience and Capabilities
  • Practical experience delivering application development or configuration within an enterprise environment.
  • Strong hands-on capability in the core technologies required by the requisition, with the ability to diagnose and resolve technical issues independently.
  • Understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including modular design, testing, debugging, version control and secure coding.
  • Experience working in Agile teams and managing work through tools such as Jira and Confluence or equivalent.
  • Experience with code review, automated testing and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Ability to communicate technical information clearly to engineering and non-engineering stakeholders.
  • Sound judgement, attention to detail, ownership and a continuous-learning mindset.
  • Ability to balance delivery pace with quality, security, maintainability and operational support needs.
Role-Specific Technical Skills
  • The requisition should identify the mandatory stack. For a Salesforce / OmniStudio vacancy, the following are relevant:
  • Salesforce platform development and configuration, including Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL and platform security concepts.
  • OmniStudio capabilities such as OmniScripts, FlexCards, DataRaptors and Integration Procedures.
  • Integration patterns and APIs, including REST/SOAP services, authentication and error handling.
  • Salesforce deployment and release practices, preferably using Git-based source control and Copado or a comparable CI/CD tool.
  • Automated and unit testing, static analysis and code-quality controls.
  • Application monitoring and log analysis using relevant observability tools.
Nice to Have
  • Relevant platform certification or equivalent demonstrable experience.
  • Experience in healthcare, insurance or another regulated industry.
  • Experience with SAFe or delivery across multiple dependent teams.
  • Awareness of accessibility, performance engineering and resilient integration design.
  • Experience using approved AI-assisted development tools to support activities such as code generation, refactoring, unit-test creation, documentation, debugging or code explanation, while applying human review, secure-coding practices and data-handling controls.
  • Experience using approved generative AI tools in day-to-day work to summarise information, improve written communication, prepare meeting outputs, explore options or streamline repeatable tasks, with appropriate validation of outputs.
  • An interest in evaluating AI use cases based on measurable value, quality, risk and responsible-use considerations.
What Good Performance Looks Like
Delivery: Completes agreed work predictably, surfaces risks early and follows through to a stable outcome.
Engineering quality: Produces maintainable, tested and secure solutions that meet agreed standards.
Ownership: Handles moderately complex work with limited oversight and takes responsibility for follow-up.
Collaboration: Works constructively across disciplines, contributes to reviews and shares knowledge.
Improvement: Identifies practical ways to reduce rework, strengthen controls and improve team effectiveness.
Responsible AI use: Uses AI as an assistive tool where permitted, validates outputs and never substitutes generated content for engineering accountability.
Education and Professional Development
Bachelor s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
Commitment to ongoing technical learning, including platform, security, cloud, automation and responsible AI capabilities relevant to the role.

We guide our customers through the health care system, empowering them with the information and insight they need to make the best choices for improving their health and vitality. Join us in driving growth and improving lives.

  2. AI Engineering (30%): Implementing Agentic workflows, RAG architectures, and LLMs to process unstructured data at scale.

  • Maintain security and privacy standards, ensuring that AI agents respect data access permissions across different departments.

  • The "Builder" Mindset: You are comfortable taking a high-level strategic requirement from leadership (e.g., "We need to automate lead qualification") and independently architecting and coding the solution.

You will be responsible for architecting an AI-first GTM ecosystem that bridges the gap between Sales, RevOps, Marketing, and Customer Success.
Your goal is to ensure that every individual in our GTM organization and every piece of our technology stack is augmented by Artificial Intelligence. You will build the bridges that allow us to generate more pipeline, accelerate deal velocity, and eliminate administrative friction, all while optimizing our tech spend.
Responsibilities:
1. AI Architecture Custom Integration
  • Design, code, and deploy custom AI integrations from scratch to connect our CRM, Sales Engagement platforms, and other technology stack components.
  • Build proprietary internal LLM-based tools to automate account and contact enrichment, outbound messaging for early and middle of the funnel prospects.
  • Develop agentic workflows that handle routine administrative tasks (e.g., CRM data, meeting summaries, and follow-up scheduling) across the revenue organization.

  • Implement predictive modeling to identify high-intent pipelines and provide Sales with real-time "Next Best Action" recommendations.
  • Ensure data integrity across all platforms, creating a "single source of truth" that AI models can leverage for accurate forecasting.
3. Cross-Functional Efficiency
  • Collaborate with Customer Success to build AI-driven retention loops and automated renewal triggers.
  • Consult with Marketing leadership on AI-driven content distribution and performance marketing automation to lower Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC).
  • Act as an internal consultant, training GTM teams on how to effectively "prompt" and utilize deployed AI tools to maximize their individual output. Qualifications

  • Proven track record of consolidating tech stacks and reducing vendor spend without sacrificing performance.

If someone says "we need 20 opportunities per quarter at 20% win rate and $75K ASD," you should immediately know where AI can compress that funnel.

  • Strong opinions on when AI should replace human effort versus augment it - and the judgment to know that bad AI automation destroys deals faster than no automation at all.

Envoy Global is a proven innovator in the global immigration space. Our mission combines our industry-leading tech platform with holistic service to streamline, simplify and expedite the immigration process for employers and individuals.
As a Product Designer, you will partner with Product Managers to turn user problems and desired outcomes into clear user journeys, testable experiences, and practical design direction. You will work closely with Product and Engineering from early problem framing through implementation, using rapid prototypes to clarify decisions, expose gaps, and improve the product experience.

This is a hands-on, early-career role for a designer who combines strong UX and product thinking with visual judgment and prototyping fluency. The role also owns the quality and continuity of clickable product demos and selected product storytelling.
As our Product Designer, you will be required to:
  • Partner with Product Managers to frame user problems, clarify desired outcomes, challenge assumptions, and identify what needs to be learned before a solution is committed.
  • Translate problems and outcomes into user journeys, task flows, interaction models, and testable experience concepts.
  • Build rapid, AI-assisted prototypes using Figma, Figma Make, Lovable, or comparable tools, selecting the lightest approach that can answer the question at hand.
  • Explore and communicate multiple design approaches, gather feedback, and iterate quickly rather than treating the first proposed screen as the answer.
  • Maintain and evolve the persistent clickable product demo so that priority workflows remain current, coherent, visually credible, and easy to present.
  • Create and update demo scenarios for Sales and stakeholder conversations when the production product does not yet tell the intended product story clearly.
  • Produce clear development reference and handoff material, including annotated flows, states, edge cases, interaction behavior, and required assets.
  • Partner with Engineering during implementation to answer experience questions, review working builds, and resolve material gaps between intent and execution.
  • Support product storytelling through product screenshots, workflow visuals, short demo recordings, and selected customer-facing visuals that directly explain the product experience.
To apply for this role, you should possess the following skills, experience and qualifications:
  • 2-4 years of experience in product design, UX design, interaction design, or a closely related role. Exceptional candidates with 1-2 years of strong, relevant work may also be considered.
  • A portfolio that shows how you moved from a user problem to journeys, alternatives, prototypes, decisions, and a usable product outcome, not only final visual screens.
  • Strong UX and product thinking, including the ability to simplify complex workflows, recognize assumptions, and connect interaction choices to user and business outcomes.
  • Prototyping fluency in Figma and comfort using Figma Make, Lovable, or comparable AI-assisted tools to move quickly from concept to testable experience.
  • Strong visual judgment and enough craft to create polished, credible prototypes and demos.
  • Clear communication and the confidence to challenge, clarify, and improve Product Manager thinking while remaining collaborative and outcome focused.
  • Comfort partnering with Engineering, producing development-ready references, learning unfamiliar tools quickly, and adapting the level of fidelity to the stage of work.

We are MG India, the strategic innovation and digital hub for MG. Established in 2003, we have offices in Mumbai and Pune.

Our teams work closely with colleagues across the Group worldwide to drive transformation, build digital capability, and support sustainable growth. By leveraging technology, AI, automation, and process excellence, we bring new ways of thinking to improve outcomes for both customers and colleagues.

Grounded in a vibrant culture with strong foundations, we are central to how MG is transforming as a business.

Our purpose is to give everyone real confidence to put their money to work. With a heritage dating back more than 175 years, we have a long history of innovation in savings and investments, combining asset management and insurance expertise to offer a wide range of solutions.

The Business Solutions Specialist plays a key role within Fleet ITs IT Operations & Supply Chain function, helping the business make better decisions through clear reporting and smarter automation.   • Create clear, reliable reporting and dashboards - primarily using Power BI, including data models (star schema) - that give business stakeholders visibility into operational and financial performance.
  • Shape the data behind those reports using Power Query (M) and DAX, so numbers stay accurate, fast to load and consistent across the business.
  • Look after reports once they go live - refresh schedules, workspace access and row-level security (RLS) in Power BI Service - so business users always see the right data, safely.
  • Turn manual, repetitive processes into simple, easy-to-use apps and forms - using Power Apps (Canvas and Model-driven), including the underlying logic and connectors that make them work.
  • Build and support automated workflows using Power Automate (Cloud and Desktop), with room to extend into RPA, AI Builder and Copilot as the platform - and your skills - grow.
  • Set up and maintain the data foundations behind these solutions - Dataverse tables, relationships, business rules and security - so everything stays reliable as it scales.
  • Follow good governance and change-management practice - moving solutions cleanly from development to testing to live, with the right approvals and data-protection policies in place - so everything stays safe, supportable and audit-ready.
  • Work closely with business stakeholders to understand what they need, and turn that into simple designs and documentation everyone can follow.
  • Be the go-to person when something isnt working - troubleshooting reporting, apps and automation issues, and escalating platform-level problems when needed.
  • Keep learning as the automation and AI landscape evolves - including RPA, GenAI and Agentic AI - and bring ideas back to improve how the team works.

Technical skills

The candidate should be able to:

Understand Analyse Design Build Test Deploy Improve

The role involves researching and developing intelligent systems capable of extracting and reasoning over text, symbols, dimensions, entities, and spatial relationships within complex engineering drawings. The candidate will contribute to the development of a Small Language Model (SLM) capable of answering questions grounded in architectural and MEP documents by combining document layout understanding, visual recognition, spatial reasoning, and domain-specific language modeling. Develop models for symbol detection, object recognition, classification, segmentation, and OCR. You will work across AI engineering, software architecture, agent orchestration, LLM applications, developer productivity, and AI-assisted software development. Agentic Engineering & AI-Augmented SDLC

AI frameworks like LangChain, LlamaIndex, and n8n are quickly becoming the default way developers build with AI - and MongoDB wants to be the data platform that shows up everywhere they build. As part of the AI Builders Experience (ABX) org, We're standing up a brand new engineering team in Gurugram to make that happen, and We're looking for Senior Software Engineers to be among its founding members.

The team owns the connective layer between MongoDB and third-party AI frameworks, platforms, and tools - the integrations that let developers use MongoDB effectively with the AI stack they''ve already chosen. That means shipping into some of the fastest-moving open-source ecosystems in tech, working mostly in Python and TypeScript, and partnering with the Database Experience (DBX) org when an integration needs new driver, platform, or product capability underneath it.

This is a self-sufficient team by design. You and your engineering manager will be based in Gurugram, and the group is set up to own its area end to end: to decide how integrations get built, tested, released, and maintained, without waiting on another time zone to unblock the day-to-day. You''ll work closest with the engineers sitting next to you, pairing on hard problems, reviewing each other's code, and dividing up a broad portfolio, while collaborating with product, partners, field teams, and open source maintainers as the work requires.

You''ll integrate with fast-moving, often unproven technologies, make pragmatic calls in the face of ambiguity, and own high-visibility projects with minimal guidance. Priorities can shift week to week based on framework changes, customer demand, and partner needs, so We're looking for product-minded engineers who thrive on autonomy and take pride in shipping. Much of your work will happen in public: sending pull requests to upstream repositories, working through external maintainer review cycles, and representing MongoDB in developer communities.

MongoDB engineering teams pride themselves on building high-quality software and living our cultural values every day - we value intellectual curiosity, intellectual honesty, customer empathy, and building together in an environment that prioritizes collaboration over competition.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.

Position expectations
  • Design, build, test, and ship MongoDB integrations across a broad AI framework ecosystem that includes technologies like LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, n8n, and Mastra, owning them from first exploratory spike through production release and ongoing maintenance.
  • Take ownership of ambiguous problems and drive them to completion independently, making sound decisions as requirements, frameworks, and customer needs evolve.
  • Do the initial, exploratory work: assess a new framework, define the smallest useful version of an integration, get it in front of users quickly, and make a clear recommendation about whether and how to invest further.
  • Contribute high-quality code upstream to repositories MongoDB doesn''t own, maintaining a high standard of professionalism and courtesy while working through external maintainer review cycles.
  • Build and maintain the team's engineering practices for a broad integration portfolio, including CI/CD, automated testing across framework and server versions, version compatibility awareness, and release readiness.
  • Own the operational health of the integrations you build - monitoring, upgrades, breaking-change response, issue triage, and follow-through after launch.
  • Partner with the Database Experience (DBX) org to define the driver, platform, and product capabilities your integrations depend on, making the case for what's needed and why.
  • Work with product management, product design, partners, field teams, and open source maintainers to define the first version and future evolution of these integrations.
  • Raise the technical bar within the team: shape architecture and development practices, give thorough code reviews, share what you know, and mentor peers and less experienced engineers.
  • Stay current with the Python, TypeScript, and broader AI builder ecosystems and bring what you learn back to the team's roadmap.
  • Bring a research and discovery mindset: notice emerging opportunities in the ecosystem, surface them early, and make the case for where MongoDB should show up next.
  • Flag issues, risks, and resource needs early and clearly, both within the team and to cross-functional partners in other regions.
Qualifications
  • Strong background in building core components for scalable, high-availability services, developer platforms, or libraries
  • 5+ years of experience building backend systems or developer-facing libraries, with strong proficiency in Python and/or TypeScript
  • Proven success in designing, writing, testing, debugging, and performance tuning software in large, long-lived code bases, including code that other developers depend on
  • Track record of identifying problems, implementing solutions, and delivering complex projects independently with minimal guidance
  • A product-minded approach to engineering, with the judgment to make pragmatic tradeoffs between fast time-to-market and long-term maintainability, and the comfort to operate amid ambiguity and rapidly evolving technologies
  • Demonstrated ability to context switch across a portfolio of projects while maintaining sound prioritization and quality.
  • Strong and demonstrated interest in modern AI builder workflows and the developer tooling landscape: AI frameworks, agentic patterns, RAG and retrieval, embedding, vector search, or adjacent areas.
  • Excellent verbal and written technical communication skills, including the ability to write things down clearly for partners you won''t always overlap with in real time.
  • Enjoys collaboration and being part of a close-knit team; is approachable, curious, and intellectually honest.
  • Eager to learn, with a strong technical background.
Nice to Have
  • Meaningful open source contributions, especially work that landed in repositories you don''t own and required navigating external maintainer review
  • Professional experience building AI or framework integrations, MCP servers, agent skills, or plugins for agentic applications
  • Familiarity with the agentic AI tooling ecosystem (AI IDEs, CLIs, and assistants) and how developers integrate with it
  • Experience building and operating CI/CD and automated testing infrastructure for libraries with many downstream version and platform combinations
  • Experience working with databases and knowledge of database internals; query optimization experience, especially with MongoDB
  • Experience with vector search, embedding pipelines, or index management
  • Working knowledge of Java, Go, C#, or Rust
  • Experience with containerization and orchestration platforms (e.g. Docker, Kubernetes) and with AI frameworks and tooling
  • Experience instrumenting usage telemetry and using it to guide investment decisions
  • Familiarity with Jira and related tool
Success measures
  • In the first month, you will understand the team's scope, the high-level architecture of our integrations, where the relevant repositories and pipelines live, and the key technical dependencies around your work. You''ll know who to go to in DBX and product, and you''ll have landed your first meaningful code contribution
  • In three months, you will own a significant integration or workstream end to end, have landed upstream contributions and established working relationships with the relevant external maintainers, and be contributing to how the team tests and releases its work
  • In six months, you will have delivered a new integration or major capability that customers are using, improved the health and maintainability of the portfolio you own, and be a trusted voice in deciding where the team invests next
  • In twelve months, you will be the recognized technical owner of a meaningful area of the portfolio, will have shaped architectural decisions and engineering practices beyond your own projects, and will be actively influencing the forward-looking technical strategy for how MongoDB shows up in the AI framework ecosystem

Designers here are active participants in shaping the work rather than recipients of finished specifications - you will help the team arrive at clarity rather than wait for it. Because our products sit on top of complex healthcare data and rapidly evolving AI capabilities, Product, Design, Data Science and Engineering deliberately open up a problem space together to build shared understanding, then converge quickly on a direction and deliver.

title: Sr. Consultant
jobDescription:
Trinity is seeking a Senior Consultant to join our growing Analytics organization with a focus on delivering data and AI-enabled analytics solutions. This role blends strong analytics execution, business understanding and practical application of AI (including GenAI and LLM-based approaches) across commercial use cases.
Trinity is a 1400-person, global organization that partners with ~350 life sciences companies annually. At the highest level, we provide Strategy, Insights, and Analytics support. Within Analytics, we have well-established SME verticals (e.g., forecasting, sales analytics, commercial data solutions, data science, AI/ML solutions).
Trinity is investing in expanding our Analytics Strategy team, a seller-doer group that owns client relationships and overall account delivery. Senior Consultants are responsible for delivery excellence, while helping scale Trinity s AI-enabled analytics capabilities.
This is a unique opportunity to join an established firm and work in an entrepreneurial environment, building and scaling a fast-growing team within a core strategic priority area for Trinity.
Position Summary
Trinity is seeking a talented, committed, and entrepreneurial individual to join our Enterprise Analytics Delivery (EAD) team as a Sr. Consultant. The EAD team acts as the pan-analytics backbone, orchestrating end-to-end execution, client partnership, and commercial growth for complex analytics programs. The Consultant is responsible for:
  • Developing analysis design for client problems, with responsibility for quality, timeliness, and business impact
  • Ensuring technical rigor across a range of analytics approaches (from descriptive and diagnostic analysis to advanced analytics and AI/ML)
The ideal candidate for this position will contribute to the firm s success through a strong work ethic, particularly in team settings, and can communicate with statisticians, data analysts, and business stakeholders alike. The Sr. Consultant should be able to independently run complex analyses, while guiding junior team members and bringing in relevant life sciences context.
Position Responsibilities:
This role is an important position within our team, engaging directly with global clients, leading internal teams, building capabilities and standard operating procedures (SOPs), and collaborating with
seamlessly with integrated Trinity teams across US, EU, and APAC.
Delivery Leadership
  • Lead specific analytical workstreams within a project, from problem framing and workplan development through analysis, synthesis, quality review, and final recommendations.
  • Understand and work with secondary RWE datasets such as claims, EMR, sales Data, Patient Level Datasets, and other real-world data sources to support commercial and analytical insights generation (e.g., IQVIA, Komodo, Symphony, Flatiron, Definitive)
  • Partner with senior project leaders within Trinity to understand and refine the contextual why for business questions and structure the insights such that inform strategy and decision-making.
  • Be responsible for analysis execution using a selection of tools like Excel (along with Copilot), SQL, R, Python, or other analytical tools
  • Identify gaps in analysis plan and data limitations as project progresses, and communicate effectively with project leaders to ensure resolution
  • Apply advanced data science methodologies and AI/ML models for client problems, support the design and deployment Trinity s technology solutions in client environments.
Mentoring and Coaching
  • Mentor and review the work of Associates, Associate Consultants and Consultants, providing feedback to strengthen problem solving, analytics execution, and client readiness.
  • Serve as direct people manager and own reporting lines; Coach team members to build stronger analytical, project management, and communication skills through day-to-day guidance and apprenticeship.
  • Teach junior team members how to use AI tools and automation responsibly in analytics delivery and operational workflows.
  • Support capability building across the EAD team by identifying development opportunities and helping junior staff grow.
Business Development Support
  • Gain methodological/ analytics approach expertise by aiding in proposal development as needed.
  • Contribute to pitch materials and case examples that showcase EAD capabilities across forecasting, brand analytics, RWE, access analytics, sales analytics, advanced modeling, AI/ML, and AI-enabled delivery.
Required Qualifications
  • Education: Bachelors degree in a quantitative, technical, scientific, business, or related field; advanced degree preferred.
  • Work Experience: 5+ years of direct work experience in a related field (life sciences consulting, biopharma analytics, and/or general consulting).
Other Important Skills:
  • Experience in life sciences, including healthcare, pharmaceutical, biotech, or medtech business questions and data.
  • Strong proficiency in analytical tools such as Excel, SQL, R, or Python, with the ability to execute and review complex analyses.
  • Experience across commercial, market, customer, and evidence-generation use cases, including
forecasting, segmentation, sales or performance analytics, access analytics, and advanced modeling.
  • Familiarity with statistical modeling, scenario analysis, machine learning, deployment-oriented workflows, and AI-enabled productivity or automation tools.
  • Experience managing and mentoring junior team members in a professional services, consulting, or analytics environment.
  • Knowledge of implementing custom AI Agents is a plus.

title: DevOps Engineer II
jobDescription:
At PDI Technologies, we empower some of the worlds leading convenience retail and petroleum brands with cutting-edge technology solutions that drive growth and operational efficiency.
By Connecting Convenience across the globe, we empower businesses to increase productivity, make more informed decisions, and engage faster with customers through loyalty programs, shopper insights, and unmatched real-time market intelligence via mobile applications, such as GasBuddy. We re a global team committed to excellence, collaboration, and driving real impact. Explore our opportunities and become part of a company that values diversity, integrity, and growth.
Role Overview:
We are looking for a DevOps Engineer II with strong hands-on experience in cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, automation, and container technologies.
The DevOps Engineer II will be responsible for implementing and supporting DevOps solutions, maintaining CI/CD pipelines, automating infrastructure and operational activities, troubleshooting issues, and supporting application teams across multiple environments.
The ideal candidate should be able to work independently on well-defined requirements, troubleshoot technical issues, and contribute to improving existing DevOps frameworks and standards.
Key Responsibilities:
CI/CD:
  • Build, maintain, and enhance CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or similar tools.
  • Configure pipelines for application build, testing, packaging, and deployment.
  • Troubleshoot pipeline and deployment failures.
  • Integrate unit testing, code-quality checks, security scanning, and other required quality gates.
  • Work with existing shared pipeline libraries, templates, and CI/CD frameworks.
  • Identify opportunities to reduce manual deployment activities through automation.
  • Support application deployments across development, test, staging, and production environments.
AWS & Cloud Infrastructure:
  • Provision and support infrastructure primarily in AWS.
  • Work with AWS services such as EC2, ECS, EKS, IAM, VPC, ALB, S3, RDS, Route 53, CloudWatch, and SSM.
  • Troubleshoot infrastructure, networking, IAM, DNS, and application connectivity issues.
  • Support infrastructure changes across multiple environments.
  • Follow established cloud architecture, security, tagging, and operational standards.
Infrastructure as Code:
  • Develop and maintain infrastructure using Terraform.
  • Modify and enhance existing Terraform modules.
  • Create Terraform configurations for new infrastructure requirements.
  • Troubleshoot Terraform plan and apply failures.
  • Manage environment-specific Terraform configurations.
  • Participate in peer reviews of Infrastructure as Code changes.
  • Follow established Terraform and IaC standards.
Automation & Configuration Management:
  • Develop and maintain Ansible playbooks for server configuration and application deployment.
  • Automate operational activities using Ansible, PowerShell, Bash, or Python.
  • Identify repetitive manual tasks and automate them.
  • Maintain and improve existing automation.
  • Troubleshoot automation failures and implement permanent fixes where possible.
Containers & Kubernetes:
  • Build and troubleshoot Docker containers.
  • Deploy and support applications running on Kubernetes/EKS.
  • Work with Kubernetes resources including:
  • Pods
  • Deployments
  • Services
  • ConfigMaps
  • Secrets
  • Ingress
  • Persistent storage
  • Work with Helm charts for application deployment and configuration.
  • Troubleshoot container startup, deployment, networking, configuration, and resource issues.
  • Basic experience with ECS/Fargate is beneficial.
Monitoring & Troubleshooting:
  • Monitor infrastructure and application health using tools such as Datadog, Grafana, Prometheus, CloudWatch, or similar platforms.
  • Troubleshoot infrastructure, CI/CD, deployment, and application environment issues.
  • Investigate alerts and operational incidents.
  • Participate in root cause analysis.
  • Identify recurring issues and recommend automation or permanent fixes.
  • Support lower and production environments as required.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation where applicable.
Platform & Developer Enablement:
  • Support Engineering teams in adopting established DevOps and platform standards.
  • Contribute to reusable CI/CD, infrastructure, and automation solutions.
  • Help automate common Engineering requests.
  • Contribute to developer self-service capabilities.
  • Document solutions, troubleshooting procedures, and operational runbooks.
  • Share technical knowledge with team members.
Qualifications
  • 3-5 years of experience in DevOps, Cloud Engineering, Platform Engineering, SRE, or a related role.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS.
  • Experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code.
  • Experience building and troubleshooting CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience with Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or equivalent CI/CD platforms.
  • Experience with Ansible or similar configuration-management tools.
  • Working experience with Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Working knowledge of Helm.
  • Experience with Git and pull-request-based development workflows.
  • Scripting experience using at least one of: PowerShell, Bash and Python.
  • Working knowledge of Linux and/or Windows administration.
  • Understanding of networking concepts including DNS, TCP/IP, Load balancers, Firewalls/Security Groups, VPCs/Subnets and Routing.
  • Ability to independently troubleshoot common infrastructure, CI/CD, and deployment issues.
Preferred Skills:
  • Experience with AWS EKS, ECS, or Fargate.
  • Experience with GitOps tools such as Argo CD.
  • Experience with SonarQube, Trivy, or other security/code-quality tools.
  • Experience with observability platforms such as Datadog, Grafana, or Prometheus.
  • Experience supporting both Windows and Linux environments.
  • AWS, Terraform, Kubernetes, or other relevant certifications are a plus.
  • Experience working in an Agile/Scrum environment.
Key Competencies:
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Automation-first mindset.
  • Ability to work independently on assigned technical requirements.
  • Good understanding of DevOps practices and software delivery processes.
  • Ability to collaborate with Engineering, Platform, CloudOps, Security, and other teams.
  • Ability to identify recurring problems and contribute to permanent solutions.
  • Good written and verbal communication skills.
  • Willingness to learn new technologies and continuously improve technical skills.
Level II Expectations
A DevOps Engineer II should be able to:
  • Independently complete well-defined DevOps tasks.
  • Build and modify CI/CD pipelines using established frameworks.
  • Provision and modify AWS infrastructure using Terraform.
  • Develop and maintain Ansible automation.
  • Deploy and troubleshoot containerized workloads.
  • Troubleshoot common infrastructure, CI/CD, and deployment issues.
  • Identify repetitive operational activities and automate them.
  • Follow established architecture, security, and engineering standards.
  • Contribute improvements to existing frameworks and reusable solutions.
  • Support and share knowledge with junior team members.
Behavioral Competencies
  • Ensures Accountability
  • Manages Complexity
  • Communicates Effectively
  • Balances Stakeholders
  • Collaborates Effectively
PDI is committed to offering a well-rounded benefits program, designed to support and care for you, and your family throughout your life and career. This includes a competitive salary, market-competitive benefits, and a quarterly perks program. We encourage a good work-life balance with ample time off [time away] and, where appropriate, hybrid working arrangements. Employees have access to continuous learning, professional certifications, and leadership development opportunities. Our global culture fosters diversity, inclusion, and values authenticity, trust, curiosity, and diversity of thought, ensuring a supportive environment for all.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. Job Summary
Role name: Senior Specialist - Technology, Bangalore. Experience: 4 to 7 years.


About the role
Our technology initiatives serve micro-enterprises-small retail shop owners, local vendors, and home-based producers. These users operate on thin margins, in patchy network conditions, often with limited digital literacy, and almost exclusively in regional languages. Very little off-the-shelf software fits their unique context and operational realities.
We are looking for an individual to own that technology stack end-to-end:
  • Field Data Collection: Supporting our frontline community partner network.
  • User Delivery: WhatsApp-first interfaces and workflows built directly for micro-business owners.
  • Localization: Voice-enabled and vernacular user interfaces.
  • Data Architecture: The underlying data layer driving core impact measurement and analytics.
  • Production AI: Deploying and scaling AI systems into active production workflows.
This is a hands-on technology role. You will work on setting the product and engineering roadmap alongside program leadership, help decide what to build, estimate technical scope, and deliver high-quality outcomes.


What you'll own
  • Design and build web and mobile applications that hold up in low-bandwidth and intermittently connected areas - offline-first, low-data, low-end Android
  • Build voice-first and vernacular interfaces for users with low digital literacy
  • Identify where AI meaningfully improves field operations including evaluation, guardrails, and inference cost control
  • Build the data layer that powers impact measurement and funder reporting: pipelines from Saathi field collection through to defined metrics, with data quality and lineage
  • Do code reviews, testing, documentation & incident response


Team and partners


Data responsibility
Own privacy and consent design for data, including obligations under Indias DPDP Act and the data commitments we make in grant agreements


Skills and experience

Essential
  • 4 - 7 years building software, with strong programming fundamentals and real problem-solving depth - able to go deep in at least one language and pick up others quickly
  • Solid database work: schema design, query design and performance, and modelling for
  • Fluency with agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) to ship quality code at high velocity
  • Good grasp of web application design - APIs, authentication, state, caching, failure modes
  • Clear written and spoken communication, and the ability to explain a technical tradeoffs


Nice to have
  • Built for low-bandwidth, rural, or offline-first contexts in India
  • Production experience with AI-native applications - systems real users depend on
  • WhatsApp Business API or comparable messaging platforms at scale
  • Speech technology (ASR/TTS) or Indic-language NLP
  • Data engineering and analytics pipeline ownership
  • Cloud infrastructure ownership on AWS or GCP, infrastructure-as-code, and cost management


Mindsets we're looking for
  • A genuine pull towards social impact - one that shows up in the tradeoffs you make, not only in your interest in the sector

  • Experience working with development teams is highly valuable.
  • Experience within SaaS, startups, software, or technology environments is a plus.


What You'll Own
  • Lead UX/UI design for conversion-focused websites.
  • Translate business objectives into clear user journeys and digital experiences.
  • Create UX flows, wireframes, responsive layouts, and polished UI designs.
  • Build clear visual hierarchy that guides users toward important actions and conversions.
  • Design experiences that balance aesthetics, usability, brand, and commercial objectives.
  • Collaborate closely with our strategy and development teams.
  • Ensure designs are practical and structured for smooth development handoff.
  • Take ownership of UX/UI decisions throughout the project.


The Mindset We Value
  • Conversion Thinking - Beautiful design is not enough. Understand what encourages users to engage, trust, and take action.
  • Customer Understanding - Think about what users need, what questions they have, and what could prevent them from converting.
  • Business Thinking - Understand the commercial objective behind the website before designing it.
  • Ownership - Take responsibility for the quality and effectiveness of the experience you design.
